RPM operates a portfolio of over 100 leading brands across three segments: Consumer (Rust-Oleum, DAP, Zinsser), Construction (Tremco, Dryvit, Flowcrete), and Performance Coatings (Carboline, Stonhard, Plasite). RPM International does not currently offer a public developer API, but its subsidiaries and brands serve the construction, maintenance, and protective coatings markets globally.

providers.name: Nike
providers.description: Nike is the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel and a major manufacturer of sports equipment, designing, developing, and marketing products under the Nike, Jordan, and Converse brands.

providers.name: truBrain
providers.description: truBrain is a Santa Monica, California nootropics and functional-beverage brand that makes "natural superfuels for performance" — drinkable nootropic shots (2,000mg of natural nootropics per 1oz bottle for focus and motivation), drinkable ketones (Ketone XL, 11g of pure ketones per shot for athletic energy and recovery), plus gummies, functional-mushroom blends, capsules, NAD+, hydration, and sleep supplements, packaged in recycled paper bottles. Founded by a team of neuroscientists and backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and has run a Regulation A+ public equity offering. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network. truBrain is a consumer packaged-goods company: it publishes no first-party developer API, documentation, or SDKs. The only machine-readable surface at its domain is Shopify's Customer Accounts OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 discovery metadata.

providers.name: Eat Just
providers.description: Eat Just, Inc. is a food technology company founded in 2011 by Josh Tetrick and Josh Balk, headquartered in Alameda, California, that makes plant-based alternatives to animal products. Its flagship product is JUST Egg, a liquid and folded plant-based egg made from mung bean protein, alongside JUST Meat, JUST Protein and JUST condiments. Its GOOD Meat subsidiary produces cultivated chicken and in December 2020 became the first company in the world to receive regulatory approval to sell cultivated meat, in Singapore, followed by US FDA and USDA approval in June 2023. The company sells through retail, foodservice, restaurant and industrial channels in North America and Europe. Eat Just publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; this profile records its public web and corporate surface only.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Chobani
providers.description: Chobani is an American food and beverage company founded in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, best known for popularizing strained Greek yogurt in the United States and for operating what it describes as the world's largest yogurt facility in Twin Falls, Idaho. Its portfolio spans Greek yogurt, oat milk, plant-based yogurt, probiotic drinks, nutritional shakes, and — following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe Coffee Roasters — ready-to-drink coffee. Chobani sells through retail grocery, an away-from-home foodservice channel, Chobani Cafe locations, and a direct-to-consumer shop. Chobani is a privately held consumer packaged goods manufacturer and does not operate a public developer program: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs, or public webhook surface, and integrates with retail and distribution partners through EDI and private supply-chain connections rather than an open API.

providers.name: DouxMatok
providers.description: DouxMatok is an Israeli food-technology company, rebranded as Incredo Ltd in May 2023, that develops Incredo Sugar — a sugar-based sugar-reduction ingredient built on a patented silica-carrier delivery technology that improves how efficiently real cane or beet sugar reaches sweet taste receptors, enabling manufacturers to cut sugar in bakery, confectionery, chocolate, spreads and nut butters by 30-50% (the company markets up to 70%) without artificial sweeteners, sugar alcohols or the aftertaste and cooling effects of alternative sweeteners. The technology is protected by more than 20 patents, was named a TIME Best Invention of 2020, and was featured in Netflix's "Explained". The company sells as a B2B ingredient to food manufacturers through distributors and partner enquiries, and is backed by Sienna Venture Capital, Pitango, DSM-Firmenich Venturing and BlueRed Partners. It is an ingredient manufacturer, not a software vendor: as of this profile it operates a twelve-page marketing website and publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: PharmaCann
providers.description: PharmaCann is one of the largest vertically integrated cannabis companies in the United States, founded in 2014 and operating cultivation centers, processing facilities and retail dispensaries across eight states — Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania. The company runs nine cultivation and processing facilities (Denver CO, Dwight IL, Lothian and Stevensville MD, Holliston MA, Warren MI, Hamptonburgh NY, Buckeye Lake OH and Olyphant PA) and sells through two retail banners, LivWell (Colorado and Michigan) and Verilife (Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania), alongside a house of product brands including Matter, Magnitude, Full Melt, CAM, P3, LivWell Flower, Hash and PC Nursery. PharmaCann is a physical-goods operator in a federally restricted, state-regulated industry; it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Smalls
providers.description: Smalls is a New York City based direct-to-consumer pet food company founded in 2017 by Matt Michaelson and Calvin Bohn, selling gently cooked human-grade fresh cat food, freeze-dried raw and treats on a personalized monthly subscription that customers build through an onboarding quiz at smalls.com, shipped nationwide and, since 2023, also sold into brick-and-mortar retail and wholesale. The company had raised roughly $34 million as of March 2023 — including a $9M Series A round announced in 2020 and a $19M Series B closed in mid-2022 — from investors including Left Lane Capital, Founder Collective, Digitalis Ventures and R/GA Ventures, and its shares trade on the Forge Global secondary market. Smalls runs its own Remix storefront on Netlify backed by a Contentful CMS rather than a hosted commerce platform, and publishes no first-party developer program: contract discovery in August 2026 found no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL endpoint, MCP server, A2A agent card, llms.txt or /.well-known documents on any smalls.com host, and no GitHub organization or public client library.

providers.name: DESERT FARMS INC.
providers.description: Desert Farms Inc. is a direct-to-consumer camel milk brand founded in 2013 by Walid Abdul-Wahab and headquartered in Santa Monica, California. The company sources 100% pure camel milk from a network of small family-owned camel dairies across the United States and sells raw and pasteurized camel milk, frozen and powdered camel milk, plus camel-milk-based soaps and skincare, direct to consumers through its Shopify storefront at desertfarms.com and through select retail grocers. Backed by 500 Global, Desert Farms is a consumer packaged goods and e-commerce company rather than an API provider; it exposes no first-party developer API. Its public web surface runs on Shopify, whose Customer Account API OpenID Connect discovery documents are served on the storefront domain for customer login. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with the domain-security, well-known, and site link-property signals that are genuinely present.

providers.name: Everdrop
providers.description: Everdrop is a Munich-based direct-to-consumer sustainability brand, founded in 2019, that sells more sustainable everyday household products — cleaning tabs, laundry detergent, dishwasher tablets, washing-up liquid and natural body care — designed around a refill model of concentrated tabs/powders dissolved in reusable bottles to cut single-use plastic, unnecessary chemicals and CO2. The company operates an e-commerce storefront (Shopify/Next.js/Storyblok stack) with a subscription-based refill program, and reports certifications including B Corp, EU Ecolabel and Ecocert. It has no public developer or API program; this profile was surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched from Everdrop's public web surface.

providers.name: Glimpse
providers.description: Glimpse (legally Dime Campus, Inc.) is an AI-native retail finance platform that automates deductions management, revenue recovery, and cash application for consumer brands and CPG companies. Its AI agents are trained on billions of dollars in retail transactions to track, validate, and dispute invalid deductions, recover trapped cashflow, and match payments faster across retailer accounts. Glimpse reports a 91% dispute win rate, $200M+ in transactions processed, and 100+ hours saved monthly per finance team, and works alongside major retailers including Walmart, Target, Kroger, Walgreens, and Amazon. The San Francisco company serves 200+ consumer brands, raised a $35M Series A, and is backed by 8vc. It is currently an enterprise, contact- sales SaaS with no public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Keychain
providers.description: Keychain is an AI-powered operating system and network for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, connecting brands and retailers with the contract manufacturers, co-packers, and suppliers that make their products. The platform lets CPG brands discover and match with vetted manufacturing partners, manage sourcing and production relationships, and streamline the supplier-discovery workflow that has traditionally been manual and relationship-driven. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Keychain was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile surfaced from the a16z venture portfolio. As of this enrichment pass Keychain publishes a marketing and product web presence at keychain.com but does not expose a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API discovery surface (no developer/API subdomain, no /.well-known catalog, no llms.txt).

providers.name: La Vie
providers.description: La Vie Foods is a Paris-based plant-based food company that makes vegan alternatives to pork products, including bacon, smoked lardons, ham, salami sticks, croquettes and meatballs, sold across French and UK retail and foodservice. Its stated mission is to move people from animal to vegetable fat without compromising on taste, citing 88% less CO2, 82% less water and 74% less land use than conventional pork. Its products are stocked by retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Waitrose, Whole Foods Market and Planet Organic, and used by restaurant partners such as Burger King. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of partech. La Vie Foods operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, CLI, packages or programmatic API surface, and exposes no /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile therefore captures the company's real public web, legal, press and domain-security surface rather than developer artifacts.

providers.name: Little Freddie
providers.description: Little Freddie (Sunny Fields Enterprise Ltd) is a UK-based organic baby and toddler food brand producing nutritious weaning products for infants from six months, developed with a paediatric dietitian to meet UK and EU baby-food guidelines. Its ranges include Greek-style yoghurts, Simply Fruit purees, Full of Veg meals, dairy-free alternatives, home-style meals and omega-3 "Good for Brains" options, sold through major UK retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, Co-op, Ocado, Booths and Spar. The company also runs a Parenting Hub with weaning, nutrition and parenting content. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; this profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Martie
providers.description: Martie is a woman-owned, San Francisco-based online discount grocery marketplace founded in 2021 to fight food waste and make quality goods accessible and affordable. Martie works directly with brands on their overstock, surplus, seasonal, and old-packaging inventory — pantry staples, beauty, and household goods — and resells it to consumers at up to 80% off retail with no membership or subscription required. Shoppers browse daily deals through the martie.com website or the Martie iOS and Android apps. The company reports having diverted over five million pounds of food from landfill since launch. Martie is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched with company identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Notti
providers.description: Notti (Notti Pet Food) is a Malaysian pet-nutrition startup selling premium slow-baked kibble, treats, and supplements for dogs (Wou Wou) and cats (Mau Mau) direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront. Formulations emphasise ">=80% fresh meat", low-temperature slow-baking to preserve nutrients, no meat meal or by-products, and AAFCO-compliant nutrition with no chemical preservatives. The company is seed-funded, has been covered by Malaysian business press (The Edge, The Star, Business Today, Free Malaysia Today), and is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company. Notti operates as a consumer e-commerce and retail brand and publishes no developer API, documentation, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: One Five
providers.description: One Five (styled one.five) is a sustainable packaging technology company based in Holm, Germany that pairs an AI-driven decision platform, Quartermaster, with ready-to-use recyclable and compostable packaging products. The Quartermaster platform embeds product-market-fit and material analysis into packaging development to accelerate material scouting and packing trials, helping consumer brands cut R&D spend, improve customer acquisition efficiency, and meet emerging packaging regulations while reducing environmental impact. One Five ships flexible sustainable packaging for categories such as dishwasher tablets and gummies through partners including Bluemorph and Glassleaf, and is backed by Speedinvest. The company offers no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Pluto Brand
providers.description: Pluto (Plutopillow) is a Los Angeles-based direct-to-consumer sleep wellness brand best known for the Pluto Pillow, a made-to-order pillow custom-built around each customer's unique sleep profile via an online sleep quiz. The company also sells the PUFF body pillow, the POD travel pillow, and temperature-regulating bedding, and offers a 125-night risk-free trial with free shipping and returns. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, Pluto is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or partner-integration surface at this time; this profile captures its public web properties for discovery.

providers.name: Ripple Foods
providers.description: Ripple Foods is a plant-based beverage company that manufactures dairy-free milk alternatives made from pea protein, along with protein shakes, kids' milk, barista and coffee creamers, and organic plant-based milk. It sells through retail grocery and a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) in the frontier-tech sector and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer packaged goods company, Ripple Foods publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public web and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: Omnifold
providers.description: Omnifold is an AI supply chain planning platform for physical product companies — CPGs, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company trains a custom AI model for each supply chain to forecast demand, optimize inventory, and surface revenue, margin, and cash that traditional planning systems miss, positioning itself in the Forbes "Purpose-Built AI" tier and competing with Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, and o9. Omnifold was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Omnifold publishes marketing and product content but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or authentication surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: P&G
providers.description: Procter & Gamble provides an API Marketplace - the central API hub for Developers, Consumers, Application Managers, and Architects to discover and use P&G APIs.

providers.name: Sealed Air
providers.description: Sealed Air Corporation (SEE) is a global packaging company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, now privately held following its acquisition by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice. It designs and manufactures food packaging, protective packaging and automated packaging equipment under the Bubble Wrap, Cryovac, AutoBag, Liquibox and NexCel brands, and pairs them with digital services including SEE Smart Service Link for connected-equipment monitoring and prismiq for digital printing and smart packaging. Its developer surface is an Azure API Management program at developer.sealedair.com whose API catalog requires a portal account, so no public OpenAPI, reference or SDK is available to an unauthenticated integrator.

providers.name: Thrasio
providers.description: Thrasio is a consumer products company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Walpole, Massachusetts, that acquires and operates e-commerce-native consumer brands — principally Amazon marketplace sellers — and then scales them with data science, supply-chain and marketing operations. The company states it is one of Amazon's top five sellers, that its products reach more than 80 million households, and that it sells across 150+ retailers. Thrasio is a brand aggregator and operator rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable specifications, and its own marketplace integrations run over Amazon's Selling Partner API rather than over any Thrasio-published interface.

providers.name: Haus Laboratories
providers.description: Haus Labs by Lady Gaga (formerly Haus Laboratories) is an American clean-beauty cosmetics brand founded by Lady Gaga. It first launched in September 2019 and relaunched in June 2022 with Sephora as its exclusive retail partner. The brand makes skincare-infused, high-performance color cosmetics and makeup — including its Triclone Skin Tech Foundation plus lip, eye, and complexion products — that are always vegan and cruelty-free. It sells direct-to-consumer through hauslabs.com and through Sephora. Haus Labs is a consumer packaged goods / beauty company with no public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio.

providers.name: Magic Spoon
providers.description: Magic Spoon is a direct-to-consumer breakfast brand selling high-protein, low-sugar cereal, oatmeal, granola, treats, and toaster pastries through its Shopify-powered online store and major retailers including Whole Foods, Target, Costco, Walmart, Kroger, and Sprouts. The company reformulates childhood-classic cereals to be keto-friendly and gluten-free, offering a subscribe-and-save model. Magic Spoon is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) ecommerce company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it operates a retail storefront rather than a public developer platform, and this profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mission Barns
providers.description: Mission Barns is a Berkeley, California cultivated-meat company founded in 2018 that grows real animal fat from cells to make animal-friendly pork products — including meatballs, bacon, pepperoni, chorizo, and sausage — built on Mission Fat, its proprietary cultivated pork fat. It is the first company to receive both FDA and USDA clearance for cultivated fat and operates a dual B2C consumer-brand and B2B ingredient / co-development model across foodservice and CPG partners. This API Evangelist profile is a portfolio-company lead (backed by Point Nine); the company runs a consumer marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Public Goods
providers.description: Public Goods is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer selling household essentials, personal care, and home products under its own private label, with an emphasis on natural formulations, simplified ingredient lists, minimalist packaging, and sustainable sourcing. The company operates a membership model (an annual fee unlocking member pricing, free shipping, and store credit) and a wholesale channel. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Stockeld Dreamery
providers.description: Stockeld Dreamery is a Swedish food-tech company founded in Stockholm in early 2019 by Sorosh Tavakoli (previously founder of the video-advertising company Videoplaza) to reinvent animal-based staples as plant-based alternatives, starting with cheese. The company develops and manufactures fermented, legume-based cultured cheese products — including a cream cheese and a melting cheese aimed at foodservice — as a sustainable substitute for dairy. Backed by venture investors including Creandum and Northzone, Stockeld Dreamery operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company
providers.description: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company is the world's largest marketer of branded consumer lawn and garden products, with brands including Scotts, Miracle-Gro, Ortho, Roundup and Tomcat. It is a physical consumer-goods manufacturer and retailer: its digital surface is a Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront and corporate site at scottsmiraclegro.com, plus end-user mobile apps. It publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable contract. The one developer-facing surface it ever marketed — the open API for the GRO connected smart-watering platform (Gro 7 Zone Controller, Gro Water Sensors) — had its cloud service discontinued on 2021-12-30 and its hosts no longer resolve. The Hawthorne Gardening Company subsidiary was divested to Vireo Growth in April 2026 and is no longer part of this company's surface.

providers.name: This Is L.
providers.description: This Is L. (L. Inc.) is a personal-care company making certified-organic cotton menstrual products — tampons, pads, and liners — sold through major U.S. retailers including Target, Walmart, Walgreens, CVS, and Kroger as well as direct-to-consumer at thisisl.com. Founded as a social enterprise and public-benefit corporation with a one-for-one give-back model, L. was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global and is now a Procter & Gamble brand (its legal, privacy, and vulnerability-disclosure surfaces resolve to pg.com). This is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce business with no public developer API, SDK, or technology platform; enrichment captured its identity, web link-properties, and security posture.

providers.name: GOOD Meat
providers.description: GOOD Meat is the cultivated-meat division of Eat Just, Inc., a San Francisco food technology company. It grows real chicken from animal cells in production bioreactors rather than by raising and slaughtering birds, and it was the first company in the world cleared to sell cultivated meat to consumers — approved in Singapore in December 2020, then cleared by the U.S. FDA in March 2023 and granted USDA label approval and grant of inspection in June 2023. Its products have been served at 1880 and Huber's Butchery in Singapore and at José Andrés' China Chilcano in Washington, D.C., and in May 2024 it became the first cultivated meat sold at retail. GOOD Meat is a consumer packaged-food and foodservice brand: it sells meat, not software. It operates no developer program, publishes no API, SDK, webhook or machine-readable specification, and its parent's GitHub organization carries no public repositories.

providers.name: HumanCo
providers.description: HumanCo is a mission-driven consumer packaged goods and wellness holding company that builds and acquires better-for-you food, beverage, and lifestyle brands made with real, clean ingredients and free of seed oils and highly processed inputs. Its portfolio spans brands and concepts such as Against the Grain (gluten-free foods), True Food Kitchen (health-focused restaurants), and Grove Collaborative (sustainable home and personal care). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. HumanCo operates a marketing and e-commerce web presence but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical developer platform at this time.

providers.name: STAND+
providers.description: STAND+ is a Techstars-backed footwear company making biomechanically engineered "energy-recovery" shoes for people who spend long hours standing or walking - healthcare workers, frontline and workforce professionals, athletes, and everyday movers. Its proprietary midsole is designed to dissipate and disperse impact energy outward rather than returning it into the joints, which the company markets for fatigue and pain reduction. The product lineup includes the AntiGrav1, AntiGrav2, and AG3 recovery shoes, the Gales Pro and Gales Frontline workforce and healthcare lines, and standalone recovery insoles. STAND+ is APMA (American Podiatric Medical Association) certified and HSA/FSA eligible through a Truemed partnership. This is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (standshoes.com) with no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: The Fit Body Co
providers.description: The Fit Body Co (Fitbody) is a Mexican direct-to-consumer sports nutrition and dietary supplements brand selling isolated and hydrolyzed protein powders, creatine, vitamins, and wellness products, along with digital recipe guides, through a Shopify-based online storefront at fitbody.mx. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As an e-commerce retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Welly
providers.description: Welly is a health and wellness brand and Certified B Corporation that designs first aid and personal care products, best known for its patterned Flex Fabric adhesive bandages, first aid kits, hydrocolloid blemish and bug-bite patches, and antiseptic wipes. Founded to make caring for everyday cuts, scrapes, and playtime injuries more joyful, Welly sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at getwelly.com and via national retail partners. As a consumer packaged-goods company it publishes no public developer API or documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Novi Connect
providers.description: Novi Connect (Novi) is an AI shopping optimization platform and data infrastructure for CPG and retail brands. It connects brands, certification bodies, and major retailers to verify, standardize, and distribute product data so products are accurately understood, ranked, and recommended by AI shopping systems and agentic search. Products include the AI Shopping Optimizer for SKU-level product-feed optimization and the Product Authority Builder for verified direct data distribution across retailers and marketplaces. Backed by Felicis. No public developer API surface is currently published; product docs are hosted on Notion and customer access is via login apps.

providers.name: Beyond Meat
providers.description: Beyond Meat, Inc. is a Los Angeles-based producer of plant-based meat substitutes founded in 2009 and publicly traded on Nasdaq (BYND). The company makes plant-protein versions of beef, pork, and poultry products, including the Beyond Burger, Beyond Sausage, Beyond Beef, and Beyond Chicken, distributed across grocery retail and foodservice channels worldwide. Beyond Meat operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand rather than a technology or developer-platform company; it publishes a marketing and e-commerce website, product and recipe catalogs, a newsroom, and an investor-relations presence, but does not offer a public developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins and Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Black Sheep Foods
providers.description: Black Sheep Foods is a San Francisco food-technology company making plant-based meat that targets the flavors and textures of premium and heritage animal proteins — starting with its signature meat-free lamb, plus steak bites, built on a proprietary pea-protein DualTexture blend. Originally launched as a restaurant and retail brand (served at Bay Area restaurants and sold as vegan ground lamb), the company has increasingly positioned itself as a B2B ingredient supplier, licensing its DualTexture protein platform for hybrid and fully plant-based meat products. It is venture-backed (investors include Bessemer Venture Partners and AgFunder) and pitches a sustainability story of far lower land, water, and greenhouse-gas footprint than conventionally raised lamb. This is a consumer/ ingredient food-tech business with no first-party public developer API; its web presence runs on Shopify.

providers.name: Datasembly
providers.description: Datasembly is a real-time retail intelligence platform that collects hyperlocal pricing, promotion, and assortment data from physical and online retail locations. The company reports gathering 12+ billion weekly prices across 150K+ stores from 230+ retailers, building a dataset of more than 2 trillion observations that consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers use to optimize pricing strategy, measure trade-spend effectiveness, monitor competitors, evaluate key value items, and plan seasonal launches. Datasembly delivers this competitive intelligence as fully shareable data and analytics rather than a public developer API. The company was acquired by SPINS. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API, developer portal, or API documentation was found on the provider's surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Frankford Candy
providers.description: Frankford Candy & Chocolate Company is a privately held, family-owned confectionery manufacturer headquartered in the Frankford neighborhood of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1947 by Russian immigrant Sam Himmelstein, the company describes itself as the "#1 Marketer of Licensed Confectionary in the United States," producing licensed novelty candy, holiday plush, hot chocolate bombs, gummies, Valentine heart boxes, and seasonal collectibles under partnerships with M&M's, Hershey, Pez, Oreo, Sour Patch Kids, Peeps, Welch's, Jif, Kraft, Disney, Marvel, Netflix, Nickelodeon, Minecraft, Super Mario, SpongeBob, Stitch, Care Bears, Elf on the Shelf, Baskin-Robbins, Dunkin', KFC, and Smucker's. Frankford acquired the Cap Candy and Wonder Ball lines from Hasbro and Nestlé in the 2000s and is one of the largest producers of chocolate Easter rabbits in the United States. This repository captures the publicly observable web surface for Frankford Candy; the company exposes no public developer API, portal, SDK, status page, or machine-readable artifacts.

providers.name: Glyph
providers.description: Glyph is a sustainable footwear brand that designs digitally knit, versatile everyday shoes engineered to be worn for every occasion. Backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through its Shopify storefront at glyph.earth, emphasizing low-waste digital knitting, single-shoe versatility, and eco-conscious materials. Glyph is a physical consumer-products (DTC e-commerce) company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its web and policy surface for network completeness.

providers.name: In Your Shoe
providers.description: In Your Shoe is an Egyptian streetwear and apparel brand, founded in 2018 and based in Cairo, Egypt, that designs and sells playful, statement-driven ready-to-wear pieces — oversized and boxy tees, shirts, jeans, jorts, loungewear, kids' lines, and accessories — letting Millennials and Gen-Z express themselves through high-quality, self-expressive fashion. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and is backed by 500 Global and the Misk 500 MENA Accelerator. It publishes no first-party developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bloom & Wild
providers.description: Bloom & Wild is a British direct-to-consumer online florist and gifting brand founded in 2013 by Aron Gelbard and Ben Stanway, best known for pioneering letterbox flowers — bouquets packed flat so they fit through a UK letterbox — alongside hand-tied bouquets, plants, gift sets, gift cards and recurring flower subscriptions. Bloom & Wild Group trades as Bloom & Wild in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany and Austria, and operates the sister brands bloomon (Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark) and Bergamotte (France) on separate storefronts. The group is a certified B Corp and runs its own commerce platform — a Ruby on Rails backend fronted by Kong, an Angular multi-brand web app and native iOS and Android clients, on AWS and GCP. Bloom & Wild publishes NO public developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable API description, and no partner or corporate-gifting API: business and bulk gifting is transacted through a contact form, an account manager and invoicing, not through a programmatic surface. The application backends at api.bloomandwild.com and capi.bloomandwild.com are live but private to the brand's own clients and undocumented. What the group does publish for machines is narrow but real: an llms.txt on the UK and German storefronts that routes assistants to the correct market by delivery destination and even ships an optional agent widget specification, and an RFC 9116 security.txt served across every group storefront.

providers.name: Kimberly-Clark
providers.description: Kimberly-Clark is a global personal care and consumer tissue company with brands including Huggies, Kleenex, Scott, Kotex, Cottonelle, Poise, Depend, and Pull-Ups. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified for Kimberly-Clark; this repository tracks corporate, supplier, and integration surfaces for ongoing API discovery.

providers.name: Daash
providers.description: DAASH is an AI-powered predictive commerce intelligence platform built specifically for the beauty and cosmetics industry. It combines consumer shopping panels covering 6M+ people with social and advertising trend data and enriched product attributes to estimate sales performance, market share, and emerging trends at the SKU level. DAASH delivers weekly competitive intelligence to beauty brands, manufacturers, and financial services firms so they can uncover category shifts, benchmark competitor performance, and spot growth opportunities. The company was founded at the intersection of predictive intelligence and consumer products by retail and data experts (Philip Smolin, CEO; Justin Stewart, CTO; Melissa Munnerlyn, CMO), and is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. DAASH is delivered as a hosted SaaS application (my.daash.co); it currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Kontoor Brands
providers.description: Kontoor Brands, Inc. is a global lifestyle apparel company with a portfolio of iconic denim and casual apparel brands including Wrangler, Lee, and Rock & Republic. Headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, the company designs, manufactures, sources, markets, and distributes its apparel products worldwide through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. Kontoor Brands does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Newlight Technologies
providers.description: Newlight Technologies, Inc. is a Huntington Beach, California biotechnology company founded in 2003 and incorporated in Delaware that produces AirCarbon, a PHB biomaterial made by naturally-occurring ocean microorganisms that consume air and greenhouse gas. The company operates a commercial-scale biomanufacturing plant and sells AirCarbon as resin to industrial partners and as finished goods under the Restore foodware and Covalent fashion-accessory brands, positioning the material as a carbon-negative, home-compostable, ocean-degradable replacement for petroleum plastic. Newlight is a materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable contract. Its only agent-reachable surface is the Wix platform Site MCP endpoint that its marketing site advertises in its own llms.txt.

providers.name: Artofsport
providers.description: Art of Sport is a consumer personal-care brand offering a complete line of daily body and skin care products made for athletes, including aluminum-free deodorant, antiperspirant, charcoal shampoo and body wash, bar soap, sunscreen, and hair care. Products are formulated with high-performance skincare science, fresh scents, clean formulas, and natural botanical ingredients. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify-powered e-commerce storefront at artofsport.com as well as retail distribution. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Art of Sport does not publish a first-party developer API; its only machine surface is the Shopify Customer Accounts OpenID Connect / OAuth authorization server exposed at the storefront host.

providers.name: Razor Group
providers.description: Razor Group (Whele LLC) is a Berlin- and Boston-headquartered consumer goods holding company that acquires, consolidates and scales profitable e-commerce brands selling on Amazon FBA, Walmart, Target, Chewy and other online marketplaces. Founded in 2020, the company has raised over $1 billion, employs 450+ people across five offices in Europe, North America and Asia, and operates more than 40,000 SKUs across brands including GymKeg, POWRX, Tranquil Spa and Porto Vino. In August 2025 Razor merged with Infinite Commerce to form the largest consolidator in the FBA aggregator space, operating a unified internal technology platform for demand forecasting, pricing and advertising. Razor Group is a buyer and operator of physical consumer products, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, SDK, webhook surface or developer portal.

providers.name: Una Brands
providers.description: Una Brands is a Singapore-headquartered, digital-age e-commerce house of brands that acquires and operates consumer e-commerce businesses across the APAC region, accelerating their growth with operational expertise and AI-led innovation from teams in Singapore, China, and Indonesia. The company publishes no public developer API, but its website ships an llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint that lets AI agents retrieve business details, search products and services, book appointments, and start purchases.

providers.name: Alkemics
providers.description: Alkemics was a French SaaS company founded in 2011 in Paris that operated a collaborative commerce platform connecting consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers to share, enrich, and distribute product content and data across the FMCG/grocery supply chain. Backed by investors including Partech, Cathay Innovation, and Serena, Alkemics was acquired by Salsify (a US product experience management company) in October 2020. The product now lives on as "SupplierXM by Salsify"; alkemics.com and docs.alkemics.com redirect to Salsify, and the successor developer documentation is hosted at docs.supplierxm.salsify.com. This company profile is preserved in the API Evangelist network with an honest acquisition/successor record. No independent Alkemics-owned API surface remains.

providers.name: Tamara Mellon
providers.description: Tamara Mellon Brand, Inc. is a Los Angeles based direct-to-consumer luxury footwear company founded in 2016 by designer Tamara Mellon, co-founder of Jimmy Choo, together with chief executive Jill Layfield. The brand sells Italian-made women's shoes and accessories straight to customers online rather than through wholesale, releasing product in monthly drops instead of following the traditional fashion calendar, and it is reported to have raised roughly $87 million in venture funding after the earlier Tamara Mellon LLC filed for Chapter 11 in 2015. In August 2025 the company announced a licensing and operating partnership with footwear licensing firm Titan Industries. It is a consumer goods retailer rather than a software company: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind. As probed on 2026-08-29 its canonical domain returns HTTP 404 on every path from an unprovisioned CDN origin, and its Shopify storefront at shop.tamaramellon.com redirects to a store password gate.

providers.name: Atomo Coffee
providers.description: Atomo Coffee is a Seattle-based food-tech company that makes beanless "molecular" coffee: it reverse-engineers the coffee bean and reconstructs the taste, aroma, and caffeine of coffee from upcycled, naturally derived plant ingredients, producing cold brew, ground, and canned products with a lower carbon and water footprint than conventional bean-grown coffee. Backed by bessemer-venture-partners and other investors, it sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at atomocoffee.com. Atomo is a consumer packaged-goods brand and publishes no first-party developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. Sector: deep-tech / food-tech.

providers.name: Impossible Foods
providers.description: Impossible Foods is a Redwood City, California food-technology company that develops plant-based substitutes for meat, including Impossible Beef, Sausage, Chicken, Meatballs, and Pork. Founded in 2011 by Patrick O. Brown, the company engineers its products around heme (soy leghemoglobin) to replicate the taste and texture of animal meat while reducing the environmental footprint of food production. Its products are distributed through grocery retail and tens of thousands of restaurants across the United States and international markets including Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. Impossible Foods is a private, venture-backed company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Spring Global
providers.description: Spring Global is an AI field intelligence platform for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, marketed as an AI operating system for the CPG field workforce. Its Field Intelligence Platform provides real-time AI coaching for field representatives, drivers, and merchandisers, compliance validation and break-adherence monitoring, automated communication with personalized recommendations, image recognition, and custom workflow automation. The platform is built on modern enterprise infrastructure (Node.js, React, AWS) and integrates with existing mobile workforce management, ERP, and retail systems rather than replacing them. Spring Global is backed by Sapphire Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition is currently published.

providers.name: Huckberry
providers.description: Huckberry is an American direct-to-consumer online retailer of men's apparel, outdoor gear and lifestyle goods, founded in 2010 by Andy Forch and Richard Greiner and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Austin and Columbus. It pairs a first-party e-commerce storefront with a large editorial operation — the Huckberry Journal — and an in-house brand portfolio, selling an "everyday adventure" assortment that sits between traditional outdoor retail and menswear. Huckberry is a retailer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable contract. Its public GitHub organization (Huckberry Inc) holds eight repositories, seven of them forks of third-party Ruby e-commerce gems — Solidus AvaTax, Affirm, Paperclip, omniauth-slack — which evidence a self-hosted Ruby storefront rather than a published platform. Partner and affiliate integration is outsourced to the Partnerize network, and customer self-service runs on a Zendesk help center tenant at help.huckberry.com.

providers.name: The Estée Lauder Companies
providers.description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) is one of the world's leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality prestige skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. Founded in 1946 by Estée and Joseph Lauder, the family-controlled, New York-headquartered conglomerate operates a portfolio of more than 20 prestige brands sold in approximately 150 countries and territories, employs roughly 57,000 people worldwide, and reported fiscal 2025 net sales of approximately $14.32 billion. ELC's corporate website (elcompanies.com) does not expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, sandboxes, or a developer portal — the EsteeLauder GitHub organization is empty of public repositories. The technology surface is instead expressed through enterprise partnerships: the AI Innovation Lab (announced 2023, expanded April 2024) jointly run with Microsoft on Azure OpenAI Service; the ConsumerIQ tool built on Microsoft Copilot Studio (2025); an Adobe Firefly Services generative AI collaboration for digital marketing assets (March 2025); a Google Gemini / Vertex AI–powered Jo Malone London Scent Advisor (December 2025); and a Shopify-based unified global direct-to-consumer commerce platform (announced October 2025, ~50% rolled out by calendar year-end 2026). ELC's strategic vision, "Beauty Reimagined" (announced February 2025), and the Profit Recovery and Growth Plan ($0.8–1.0B gross benefits; $1.2–1.6B restructuring charges) anchor the One ELC operating model now led by CEO Stéphane de La Faverie and Board Chair William P. Lauder.

providers.name: Reynolds American
providers.description: Reynolds American Inc. is the second-largest tobacco company in the United States and a subsidiary of British American Tobacco (BAT). Its subsidiaries include R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Company (Camel, Newport, Pall Mall), American Snuff Company (Grizzly, Kodiak), Santa Fe Natural Tobacco Company (Natural American Spirit), and R.J. Reynolds Vapor Company. Reynolds American does not offer a public developer API or data services.

providers.name: Bunge
providers.description: Bunge Global SA is a multinational agribusiness and food company connecting farmers to consumers by sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products. Operates across grain origination, oilseed processing, refined and specialty oils, milling, sugarcane and biofuel production, and fertilizer sales. In 2025 Bunge completed its merger with Viterra to create a major global agricultural trading and processing platform.

providers.name: Crown Holdings
providers.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and sale of rigid packaging products for consumer goods, including metal beverage cans and ends, food cans, aerosol cans, specialty closures and promotional tins, as well as transit and protective packaging products for industrial markets. The company operates in more than 40 countries and supports customers with design, decoration, reprographics, compound development, pilot facilities, and seaming training services. Crown Holdings does not publish a public developer API program; technical collaboration with customers happens through B2B and EDI channels.

providers.name: Green Thumb Industries
providers.description: A leading U.S. cannabis consumer packaged goods company operating a nationwide portfolio of retail dispensaries under the RISE brand and a collection of cannabis brands. Operates manufacturing facilities and retail locations across multiple states.

providers.name: Heineken
providers.description: A Dutch multinational brewing company and one of the world's largest beer producers. Operates over 165 breweries across 70 countries producing iconic brands including Heineken, Amstel, Tecate, and Dos Equis. Maintains an internal HEIWAY API portal (api-portal.production.az.heiway.com) used for partner, distributor, and on-trade B2B integrations; access is gated and not openly published.

providers.name: ShelterLogic Group
providers.description: ShelterLogic Group is the world leader in shade, shelter, storage, and outdoor lifestyle products with over 70 years of industry experience. Launched in 1991, ShelterLogic develops tough, affordable shelter solutions for everyday consumers and commercial customers. The company operates three manufacturing facilities in the US and China and maintains worldwide distribution. The ShelterLogic brand portfolio includes ShelterLogic, SOJAG, Arrow Storage Products, Quik Shade, CAMP&GO, RIO Beach, and licensed brands including Tommy Bahama, Margaritaville, Life is Good, and Scotts Miracle-Gro. As a B2C manufacturer and retailer, ShelterLogic does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Silgan Holdings
providers.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is a leading global sustainable packaging provider for consumer goods products. The company partners with customers to deliver essential products to the world in efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective packaging formats. Silgan operates through three primary business segments: Dispensing and Specialty Closures, Metal Containers, and Custom Containers. With 123 manufacturing facilities on four continents, over 17,200 employees, and approximately $6 billion in annual sales, Silgan serves the food, beverage, healthcare, home and garden, personal care, fragrance, and beauty end markets.

providers.name: WhiteWave Foods
providers.description: The WhiteWave Foods Company was a consumer packaged food and beverage company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It offered plant-based foods and beverages, coffee creamers, dairy, and organic produce under brands including Silk, So Delicious, Horizon Organic, International Delight, LAND O LAKES, Vega, Wallaby Organic, and Earthbound Farm. WhiteWave was acquired by Danone in April 2017 and is now part of Danone North America.

providers.name: AAK
providers.description: AAK AB is a Swedish producer of value-adding plant-based oils and fats, headquartered in Malmö and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ticker AAK) in the Food & Beverage large-cap segment. It was formed in 2005 through the merger of Denmark's Aarhus United and Sweden's Karlshamns AB, and describes more than 150 years of combined experience in specialty vegetable oils. The company employs roughly 4,000 people across 19 production facilities, 25 regional sales offices and 16 Customer Innovation Centers, and works through a co-development model with customers in chocolate and confectionery, bakery, dairy and ice cream, plant-based foods, special nutrition, foodservice and retail, personal care, animal nutrition, candles and technical products such as fatty acids and glycerine. Its product is a physical industrial ingredient, not software: no developer program, public API, SDK, developer portal, machine-readable contract or GitHub organization could be found, and no api/developer/docs/portal hostname resolves under aak.com.

providers.name: Chiquita Brands International
providers.description: Chiquita Brands International is a leading global producer, marketer, and distributor of bananas and other fresh produce, recognized worldwide by the iconic Blue Sticker on its bananas. Founded in 1899 as the United Fruit Company and rebranded as Chiquita in 1990, the company is headquartered in Etoy, Switzerland (with significant operations in Fort Lauderdale, Florida) and sources fruit from plantations across Latin America (Honduras, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, and Ecuador) for distribution in the United States, Europe, and other markets. Beyond core Cavendish bananas, Chiquita markets specialty banana varieties (organic, Reds, Manzanos, Minis), plantains, pineapples (including the Sunburst Gold variety), and partners with retailers worldwide. Chiquita does not currently publish a consumer-facing developer API; supplier, retailer, and grower integrations are managed through internal portals and bilateral EDI systems, and consumer-facing digital experiences focus on recipes, sticker collection campaigns, and retail merchandising.

providers.name: Coty
providers.description: Coty Inc. is one of the world's largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin and body care. The company operates two divisions: Prestige (premium fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare brands such as Gucci, Burberry, Calvin Klein, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Tiffany, Chloe, Davidoff, Lancaster, philosophy, and Kylie Cosmetics) and Consumer Beauty (mass-market color cosmetics, hair care, and body care brands such as CoverGirl, Rimmel, Max Factor, Sally Hansen, Bourjois, and Adidas). Coty does not publish a public developer API; supplier and partner integrations occur through the Coty Supplier Portal and B2B / EDI channels.

providers.name: Eversight
providers.description: Eversight is an AI-powered pricing and promotions software company serving consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers. Its SaaS platform runs continuous, controlled experiments testing untried everyday prices and promotional offers with real shoppers, then applies advanced analytics and AI-powered experimentation to surface revenue-optimizing price and offer recommendations. The product is delivered as two suites — a Retail Pricing Suite that integrates with physical and digital store networks, and an Offer Innovation Suite for CPG trade-promotion teams that deploys standalone or on top of existing TPM systems. Eversight was founded in 2013, acquired by Instacart in 2022, and targets revenue-management, trade-marketing, sales, pricing, and merchant teams. It is a portfolio company of Emergence Capital. No public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal is published — the platform is an enterprise SaaS engagement.

providers.name: Miniso
providers.description: MINISO is a global value retailer of lifestyle and consumer products — home goods, accessories, cosmetics, stationery, toys and seasonal items — known for its IP-collaboration merchandise (Harry Potter, PEANUTS, Sanrio, BT21 and others). Founded in Guangzhou, China and publicly listed (NYSE/HKEX), the company operates 7,700+ stores across 112 markets worldwide. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; the public web presence is consumer- and investor-facing and exposes no developer API, developer portal, or partner integration platform at this time.

providers.name: Smallhold
providers.description: Smallhold is a specialty organic mushroom company founded in 2017 by Andrew Carter and Adam DeMartino and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. A Certified B Corporation, Smallhold grows gourmet mushroom varieties — including blue oyster, lion's mane, maitake, royal trumpet, and shiitake — using modular, automated "minifarm" growing environments designed for distributed, locally grown supply to grocery retailers and restaurants. Its public presence is a direct-to-consumer and retail-partner storefront built on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and run through the enrichment pipeline, which confirmed no bespoke API surface — only Shopify's platform OAuth discovery documents are exposed on the shop domain.

providers.name: Kaizntree Inc.
providers.description: Kaizntree is a New York-based operations platform for growth-stage consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands, giving multi-channel manufacturers and sellers a single system to run purchasing, inventory, sales, fulfillment, production, and lot-level traceability. Its two products are Kaizntree OS, a cloud ERP that centralizes stock across raw materials, intermediate goods, packaging, finished and bundled products with COGS, margin, multi-location, batch/expiry and audit-ready records, and JP, an ERP-agnostic AI operations assistant that automates high-volume workflows such as purchase-order processing, reporting, data synchronization, and OTIF tracking. Kaizntree integrates with sales channels (including Shopify), accounting, WMS, and fulfillment platforms. Backed by 500 Global (seed, 2022), it operates on usage-based pricing. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Kaizntree publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Notco
providers.description: NotCo (The Not Company) is a food-technology company founded in 2015 in Santiago, Chile that uses artificial intelligence — its proprietary "Giuseppe" platform — to reverse-engineer animal-based foods from plant ingredients. Its consumer brand at notco.com sells plant-based products including NotMilk, NotMayo, NotBurger and NotIceCream across the Americas, while NotCo AI (notco.ai) licenses the Giuseppe AI R&D platform to global CPG manufacturers such as PepsiCo, Magnum and Barry Callebaut to accelerate food-product innovation. The company is backed by General Catalyst and other investors. NotCo publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its corporate, product, AI-platform and trust/compliance web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: VF Corporation
providers.description: VF Corporation is a global apparel and footwear company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. VF owns major brands including Vans, The North Face, Timberland, Altra, Eastpak, Icebreaker, JanSport, Kipling, Napapijri, and Smartwool. The company does not offer a public developer API program; its technology integrations are handled through third-party e-commerce platforms and enterprise supply chain systems. VF Corporation operates more than 1,500 stores globally and integrates with platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, Magento, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce via third-party integration services.

providers.name: Bassetts Ice Cream
providers.description: Bassetts Ice Cream is a Philadelphia ice cream brand founded in 1861 and self-described as "America's oldest ice cream brand." The company is family-owned across six generations of the Bassett / Strange family, retails out of a single counter at Reading Terminal Market in Center City Philadelphia, and operates a wholesale frozen-dessert distribution business serving restaurants, hotels, country clubs, dipping parlors, supermarkets, and caterers within a 40-mile radius of Philadelphia (with distributor partners in the New York metro and Florida). Bassetts also exports to China (since 2008), South Korea (2017), and Taiwan (2020), and ships pints nationwide via Goldbelly. The corporate office is at 1211 Chestnut Street, Suite 410, Philadelphia, PA. The bassettsicecream.com website is hosted on Wix and exposes no public API, no developer portal, and no machine-readable product catalog.

providers.name: Berry Global
providers.description: Berry Global is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials for consumer and industrial end markets. In 2024, Berry Global merged with Amcor to form one of the world's largest packaging companies. Berry's products include rigid open top packaging, closures and dispensing systems, flexible packaging, tapes, and engineered materials.

providers.name: A-Frame
providers.description: A-Frame Brands is a Los Angeles-based consumer brand incubator and product-development company founded in 2019 by entrepreneur Ari Bloom and actor Hill Harper. It partners with celebrities and cultural figures to build purpose-driven personal-care, beauty, fragrance, home-care, and pet-care brands, taking each from opportunity identification through product development, design, sourcing, production, and retail go-to-market. Brands in its portfolio include LOVED01 (John Legend), Kinlo (Naomi Osaka), Proudly (Gabrielle Union and Dwyane Wade), and Purrfect Paws, sold through retailers such as Target, Walmart, Amazon, CVS, JCPenney, QVC, and Bath & Body Works. Backed by Initialized Capital. This is a consumer company profile in the API Evangelist network; A-Frame publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Caba
providers.description: CABA Design Co. is a direct-to-consumer home-furnishings company building the next generation of furniture brands powered by community and technology. It develops sustainable, high-quality furniture and gives customers choice through customization and modularity, selling directly through its Shopify-hosted storefront at cabadesign.co under the tagline "Your Home. Your Way." Caba was surfaced as a portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a company stub; it publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and does not currently expose a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile captures the identity, storefront, and domain/security posture verified during enrichment.

providers.name: Central Coast Agriculture
providers.description: Central Coast Agriculture, Inc. (CCA) is a vertically integrated California cannabis cultivator and manufacturer headquartered in the Santa Ynez Valley north of Santa Barbara, best known for its Raw Garden brand of fresh-frozen concentrates, vapes and infused pre-rolls. The company describes itself as a progressive farm focused on utilizing science and sustainability to grow quality, modern crops, and operates its own farming, genetics/breeding and extraction programs. It is a physical agricultural and consumer-packaged-goods business: it publishes a corporate site, a consumer brand site and a wholesale ordering page, but no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Peach
providers.description: Peach (Peach, inc., ticker PEAC on secondary markets) was a Waltham, Massachusetts direct-sales retailer of intimate apparel, basics and athleisure for women, founded in 2013 by Janet Kraus (CEO) and Derek Ohly. It blended an in-home personal-styling experience delivered by a network of independent stylists with an online replenishment storefront at discoverpeach.com, raising roughly $10.2M before winding down. The company has since closed: its own homepage carries a farewell notice ("Peach has closed its doors") and refers customers to Cabi Clothing. Peach was a consumer retail brand, not a software vendor — it never operated a developer program, published no API documentation, and no machine-readable contract of any kind was found on its surviving surface.

providers.name: THIS
providers.description: THIS™ is a UK plant-based food company making high-protein vegan meat alternatives — including meat-free chicken, bacon, sausages, burgers and mince — sold through major British supermarkets such as Tesco, Sainsbury's, Waitrose, Ocado, Morrisons, Asda and Co-op. Founded in 2019 and backed by Seedcamp, THIS™ is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) brand focused on absurdly tasty plant-based food rather than a developer platform. It operates a marketing and recipe website but publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Finless Foods
providers.description: Finless Foods is an Emeryville, California cellular-agriculture company founded in 2017 by Michael Selden and Brian Wyrwas to grow real seafood from fish cells instead of harvesting it from the ocean. Its scientists established proprietary marine cell lines and a culture-media and bioreactor process that cultivates bluefin tuna and other high-value species into three-dimensional tissue with comparable taste, texture and nutrition to wild-caught fish, and the company has also shipped a plant-based tuna alternative into foodservice while the cell-cultivated line moves toward regulatory clearance and commercial launch. Backed by SOSV/IndieBio and a USD 34 million Series B closed in March 2022, and now led by co-founder and CEO Brandon Chen with co-founder Brian Wyrwas as CSO, Finless Foods is a food-biotechnology and consumer-products business rather than a software vendor: it operates a single-page Squarespace marketing site with a Squarespace Commerce cart, publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its 2017-era GitHub organization holds one dormant static-HTML repository.

providers.name: Keurig Dr Pepper
providers.description: Keurig Dr Pepper is a leading North American beverage company formed by the 2018 merger of Keurig Green Mountain and Dr Pepper Snapple Group. It operates a portfolio of more than 125 owned, licensed, partner, and allied brands across hot and cold beverages, including Keurig single-serve brewing systems and brands such as Dr Pepper, 7UP, Snapple, Mott's, Bai, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, and Peet's Coffee.

providers.name: Sonoco Products
providers.description: Sonoco Products Company is a global leader in sustainable metal and fiber consumer and industrial packaging, operating 285 facilities across 40 countries with 23,000+ employees. Products include metal packaging (aerosol cans, steel food cans, closures), rigid paper packaging (paper containers, fiber cartridges), industrial paper packaging (tubes, cores, recycled paperboard), and industrial specialty packaging (plastic components, reels, spools). Serves food and beverage, pet care, household products, beauty, automotive, and industrial markets. A Fortune 500 company (NYSE: SON).

providers.name: Thrive Market
providers.description: Thrive Market is a membership-based online grocery retailer headquartered in Marina del Rey, California, selling organic and natural food, pantry staples, frozen meat and seafood, beauty and personal care, baby, pet and household products directly to consumers across the United States. Members pay an annual or monthly fee in exchange for below-retail pricing, and the company operates its own Thrive Market private label alongside thousands of third-party brands. It filters its catalog by diet, ingredient, certification and social value, accepts EBT/SNAP for grocery purchases, and funds free memberships for lower-income families through its Thrive Gives program. Thrive Market is a direct-to-consumer commerce company: it ships a website and mobile apps to shoppers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Avon Products
providers.description: Avon Products is a global manufacturer and marketer of beauty and related products, primarily distributed through a network of independent sales representatives.

providers.name: ConAgra Foods
providers.description: ConAgra Foods, Inc. was the prior corporate name of Conagra Brands. In 2015 the company spun off its foodservice ingredients business as Lamb Weston and renamed the remaining packaged-foods business to Conagra Brands, Inc. This profile is preserved as a historical alias; the active company profile lives at the conagra-brands repository. No public developer APIs were ever published under the ConAgra Foods brand.

providers.name: Achats Group
providers.description: Achats Group (아샤그룹) is a South Korean media-commerce company founded in February 2017 and led by CEO Vivian Eun Young Lee, with offices in Pangyo (Seongnam) and Magok (Seoul). It manufactures and sells everyday consumer goods — sanitizing and deodorizing sprays, foot care, living care, health drinks and cosmetics — under its own brands Cellomon, ND247 / Neverdie, Biotreat and BringB, marketing them through short-form video and social advertising that routes buyers into its own Cafe24 storefronts and a Naver Smart Store. Public records put total funding near USD 6.2 million through a Series B. It is a direct-to-consumer consumer-goods business, not a software vendor: as of 2026-09-06 achatsgroup.co.kr is a Cafe24-hosted brochure site still carrying unedited pages from its purchased template, with no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and the brand storefronts are hosted Cafe24 malls whose only /api path is Cafe24's own.

providers.name: Topgolf Callaway Brands
providers.description: Topgolf Callaway Brands is a global golf and entertainment company that designs, manufactures, and sells golf clubs, balls, apparel, and accessories under the Callaway, Odyssey, OGIO, TravisMathew, and Jack Wolfskin brands, and operates Topgolf entertainment venues and the Toptracer ball-tracking technology. Topgolf Callaway Brands does not publish a single public developer API portal, though Toptracer ball-tracking technology is licensed to driving ranges through a separate commercial program.

providers.name: Wolverine World Wide
providers.description: Wolverine World Wide is a leading designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded footwear, apparel, and accessories. Brands include Merrell, Saucony, Wolverine, Sperry, Sweaty Betty, and Hush Puppies. The company operates global wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and digital commerce channels. Wolverine World Wide does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Brown-Forman
providers.description: Brown-Forman Corporation is one of the largest American-owned spirits and wine companies in the world, established in 1870 and headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The company produces, bottles, imports, exports, markets, and sells a wide variety of alcoholic beverages under brands including Jack Daniel's, Woodford Reserve, Old Forester, Herradura, El Jimador, Slane Irish Whiskey, Benriach, Chambord, Diplomático, and Ford's Gin. Brown-Forman is traded on the NYSE under tickers BF.A and BF.B.

providers.name: Curaleaf Holdings
providers.description: The largest cannabis company in the world by revenue operating cultivation, processing, and retail dispensary operations. Operates in multiple U.S. states and international markets producing cannabis flower, pre-rolls, edibles, and vape products under leading brands.

providers.name: Nestlé
providers.description: Nestlé S.A. is the world's largest food and beverage company by revenue, headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland. Its product portfolio spans coffee (Nescafé, Nespresso), water, pet food (Purina), baby and infant nutrition (Gerber, Cerelac), confectionery (KitKat), dairy, and health science. No public developer portal or external API offering has been identified for Nestlé; integrations with retailers and partners are handled through private B2B systems rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Big Lots
providers.description: Big Lots is a discount retailer offering a wide assortment of brand-name closeout merchandise including furniture, food, consumables, seasonal products, soft home, hard home, and electronics. Big Lots operated hundreds of stores across the United States. In 2024, Big Lots filed for bankruptcy and its brand and operations were acquired by Nexus Capital Management.

providers.name: Callisto Media
providers.description: Callisto Media Inc. was a data-driven nonfiction book publisher founded in 2011 by chief executive Benjamin Wayne, operating from 1955 Broadway in Oakland, California (earlier Emeryville) and 220 West 19th Street in New York. It built a publishing model around demand signals rather than editorial instinct — mining point-of-sale data, search volume and category gaps to decide which instructional titles to commission, then matching each topic to a subject-matter author. Its primary imprint was Rockridge Press, best known for diet-, appliance- and condition-specific cookbooks and health titles, alongside the Callisto Kids line of pre-K through grade 12 workbooks, STEM, history and biography titles; the company said it had reached more than 50 million customers and ranked among the top fifteen US publishers by unit sales. It raised venture funding from 137 Ventures in 2017, then contracted sharply — cutting 35 percent of staff in July 2022 and a further 200 roles that October — and on 9 May 2023 its publishing assets were acquired by the independent publisher Sourcebooks in a deal funded by Penguin Random House, with Simon & Schuster Distribution Services continuing to distribute the titles. The brand now trades as Callisto Publishing, a Sourcebooks imprint: callistomedia.com 301-redirects to callistopublishing.com, which 301-redirects again to sourcebooks.com/callisto (chain verified 2026-08-02). Callisto Media is a consumer publishing business, not a software vendor, and has no public API surface. Probes on 2026-08-02 against callistomedia.com, www.callistopublishing.com and www.sourcebooks.com returned no machine-readable contract: /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /.well-known/ai-plugin.json all 404, /.well-known/agent-card.json and /.well-known/agent.json both 404 (no A2A agent card), and every other probed path answered with the Sourcebooks single-page Magento storefront shell rather than a document. There is no developer portal, no GitHub organization (callistomedia, callisto-media and rockridgepress all 404 on the GitHub API), no published SDK on npm or PyPI, and no llms.txt.

providers.name: Tupperware Brands
providers.description: Tupperware Brands Corporation was an American multinational consumer goods company that manufactured and marketed premium kitchen storage, preparation, and serving products under the Tupperware brand, as well as related home product lines. The company distributed products to approximately 70 countries through independent sales force members. Tupperware Brands filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2024 and underwent liquidation in 2025. The Tupperware brand name was subsequently acquired by Party Products LLC. No public developer API program was available during the company's operation.

providers.name: Hormel Foods
providers.description: Hormel Foods Corporation is a global branded food company with over $12 billion in annual revenue. Known for brands like SPAM, Skippy, Jennie-O, Hormel, and Planters. The company produces and markets a wide range of meat, nut, and food products. No public APIs were identified.

providers.name: Simple Love Yogurt
providers.description: Simple Love (简爱酸奶) is a Chinese natural yogurt brand operated by Pucheng Dairy (Group) Co., Ltd. (朴诚乳业), founded in 2016. Known for zero-additive, low-temperature fresh yogurts with short ingredient lists — including its no-sugar, probiotic, high-protein, and coconut lines — the brand is distributed across supermarket shelves in every Chinese province and operates its own manufacturing capacity in Hebei. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a consumer packaged-goods (CPG) dairy company it publishes a corporate/consumer website but no public developer, API, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Onda
providers.description: Onda is a ready-to-drink spirits brand that makes canned sparkling tequila — blanco tequila from a woman-owned distillery in Jalisco, Mexico, blended with sparkling water and real fruit juice and sold in 12 oz cans at 5% ABV, 100 calories, zero sugar and naturally gluten free, in lime, blood orange, watermelon and grapefruit. The company was founded in 2019 and launched publicly in July 2020 by Noah Gray (CEO), Max Dworin (COO), Kelli Adams (CCO) and actor-producer Shay Mitchell (Chief Brand Officer). It raised a $5M Series A in 2021 and a $12.5M growth round in 2022 from existing investors including Aria Growth Partners and 25madison, and sells through national grocery, liquor retail and third-party beverage e-commerce alongside its own direct-to-consumer store. NO PUBLIC API SURFACE: Onda is a consumer packaged goods company, not a software vendor — there is no developer program, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Its only owned web property, drinkonda.com, is a Shopify storefront that on 2026-08-26 returned HTTP 404 "This store is unavailable" on every path probed, with a robots.txt that disallows all crawling and a Shopify-generated /llms.txt that states agent interaction is not possible; the last archived working capture of the storefront is 2026-02-18. Onda appears in the API Evangelist network because it trades on the private secondary market (EquityZen, Nasdaq Private Market), not because it publishes an API.

providers.name: Chefs' Warehouse
providers.description: The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. (NASDAQ: CHEF) is a premier distributor of specialty food products to high-end independent restaurants, fine dining establishments, country clubs, hotels, caterers, culinary schools, bakeries, and specialty food stores across North America and the Middle East. The company offers a broad portfolio of artisan, exotic, and signature ingredients spanning center-of-the-plate proteins, specialty dry goods, produce, pastry, cheese and charcuterie, dairy and eggs, oils and vinegars, and kitchen supplies. Customers order through a B2B e-commerce platform (re-platformed to Optimizely B2B in 2021, previously Magento) and companion iOS and Android wholesale-ordering apps built in partnership with Unbound Commerce. As of this profiling, Chefs' Warehouse does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or open-source repositories; its digital surface is a buyer-facing ordering experience rather than a programmatic API. This profile documents the company's public footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: General Mills
providers.description: General Mills is a leading global food company that manufactures and markets branded consumer foods including Cheerios, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Haagen- Dazs, Nature Valley, Old El Paso, and Progresso. General Mills operates in over 100 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API portal and primarily relies on EDI and direct supply chain integrations with retail partners.

providers.name: Hasbro
