providers.description: Hasbro is a global play and entertainment company committed to making the world a better place for children and their families through brands and franchises including NERF, MAGIC: THE GATHERING, MY LITTLE PONY, and TRANSFORMERS. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Hasbro. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.

providers.name: Jarden
providers.description: Jarden Corporation was an American consumer products conglomerate that owned brands across Outdoor Solutions (Coleman, K2 Sports, Marmot, Rawlings), Consumer Solutions (Crock-Pot, Mr. Coffee, Sunbeam, Oster, FoodSaver), Branded Consumables (Yankee Candle, First Alert, Diamond Match), and Process Solutions. Jarden was acquired by Newell Rubbermaid on April 15, 2016, with the combined entity rebranded as Newell Brands. As such, Jarden no longer exists as an independent company and does not maintain its own APIs.

providers.name: Lego
providers.description: The LEGO Group is a Danish toy company and the world's largest manufacturer of interlocking plastic building bricks. The company extends its brand across video games, theme parks, movies, educational products, and licensed sets for children and adults. LEGO does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; consumer-facing systems and partner integrations are closed. A public GitHub organization hosts internal engineering tooling and open-source contributions.

providers.name: Lululemon Athletica
providers.description: Lululemon Athletica is a designer, distributor, and retailer of technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories for women, men, and girls. Lululemon does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; digital integrations are handled through partner relationships and internal ecommerce, retail, and supply-chain platforms.

providers.name: Babycare
providers.description: Babycare is a Chinese mother-and-baby (母婴) consumer brand offering a broad range of maternity and infant-care products, including diapers, wipes, strollers, baby carriers, feeding bottles, toys, and maternal care goods. It operates primarily as a direct-to-consumer brand, selling through major Chinese e-commerce marketplaces (Tmall, JD.com, Douyin) alongside its own channels and offline retail, and is one of the leading new-generation mother-baby brands in China. Babycare is backed by venture investor Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). This profile is a consumer-brand entry in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface has been identified for this provider.

providers.name: Beast Industries
providers.description: Beast Industries is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of social-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: creator-economy. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Berry Plastics Group
providers.description: Berry Plastics Group was a manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials serving customers across consumer and industrial markets. The company was renamed Berry Global Group in 2017 to reflect its global operations and diversified product portfolio beyond plastics. As Berry Global, the company subsequently merged with Amcor in 2024.

providers.name: Big Heart Pet Brands
providers.description: Big Heart Pet Brands was a producer and marketer of branded pet food and snacks with brands including Meow Mix, Milk-Bone, Kibbles 'n Bits, 9Lives, Natural Balance, Pup-Peroni, Gravy Train, Nature's Recipe, Canine Carry Outs, and Milo's Kitchen. Big Heart Pet Brands was acquired by The J.M. Smucker Company in 2015 and no longer operates as an independent entity. All brands are now managed under J.M. Smucker's Pet Foods division.

providers.name: BrandCT
providers.description: BrandCT (品牌CT) is an offline-retail market-monitoring service operated by Mashangying (马上赢市场调查 / yikuaigao), a Chinese retail-data company. It has built a national offline-retail monitoring network based on POS data from a panel of sample stores, and delivers brand owners a "BrandCT" service that scans more than 10 million products across offline retail formats to quantify market share, distribution (铺市率), and product sell-through. The platform supports quantitative analysis of product innovation, channel competition, and category trends to speed up and sharpen client decision-making. The product is delivered through a login-gated web dashboard (WeChat, phone, and email verification sign-in); no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: C16 Biosciences
providers.description: C16 Biosciences is a New York City based synthetic biology company producing high-performance, sustainable ingredients for consumer goods manufacturers through its proprietary Palmless platform. Using microbial fermentation and biotechnology, C16 designs plant-free, deforestation-free alternatives to palm oil and petroleum-derived commodity ingredients for beauty and personal care, food, and home and personal care markets. Its flagship Palmless Torula Oil is a bioactive super-emollient with antioxidant properties for skincare formulations, alongside designer fats, oils, fatty acids, triglycerides, and alcohols. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCVC; it is an ingredients and biomanufacturing business and does not currently publish a public developer platform or API.

providers.name: Caleres
providers.description: Caleres is an American footwear company headquartered in Clayton, Missouri, established in 1878 (rebranded from Brown Shoe Company in 2015). It designs, develops, sources, manufactures, and distributes footwear through its Famous Footwear retail segment (approximately 900 U.S. locations) and Brand Portfolio segment which includes Sam Edelman, Stuart Weitzman, Allen Edmonds, Naturalizer, Vionic, LifeStride, Dr. Scholl's, Rykä, Franco Sarto, and Blowfish Malibu. Caleres does not currently publish a public developer API program; integrations are typically handled through B2B EDI and partner channels.

providers.name: Cap Hill Brands
providers.description: Cap Hill Brands was a Seattle-based e-commerce brand aggregator founded in 2020 by Kevin Saliba and Jason LeeKeenan (both former Zulily leaders). Operating as a "tech-first" Amazon aggregator, it acquired and operated digitally-native consumer/CPG brands sold on Amazon, Walmart, and Shopify, handling supply chain, marketing, and warehousing. It raised roughly $250M in debt and equity and acquired nearly 35 brands (including Butterfly Craze, merka, and LilGadgets). In March 2024 Cap Hill Brands merged with product developer Juvo+ to form Infinite Commerce, which has since been absorbed into Razor Group. Cap Hill Brands is a consumer operating company, not an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, or partner integration surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures and retained in the API Evangelist network as an identity record.

providers.name: Chi Forest
providers.description: Chi Forest (marketed as CHI FOREST) is the US-facing consumer beverage brand of the Chinese drinks company Genki Forest (元气森林), backed by Hongshan (Sequoia China) and IDG Capital. The company produces zero-sugar, zero-calorie, zero-caffeine sparkling refreshers with Asian-inspired, fruit-forward flavors such as guava and lychee, distributed through retailers including Costco, Amazon, and H Mart. It is a direct-to-consumer and retail beverage brand with a marketing/e-commerce web presence and no public developer platform, API, or documentation surface at this time. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company record.

providers.name: CleanCo
providers.description: CleanCo is a United Kingdom-based beverage company, founded in 2019 by Spencer Matthews, that produces premium low- and no-alcohol alternative spirits. Its product line replicates the flavour profiles of traditional spirits across key categories, including CleanGin, CleanRum, CleanVodka and CleanTequila, aimed at consumers who want to reduce alcohol consumption without sacrificing taste. The company sells direct-to-consumer through cleanliquor.com and through grocery and hospitality retail channels across the UK and international markets. CleanCo raised venture funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2020. It is a consumer packaged-goods brand and does not publish a developer API, developer portal, or any machine-readable API surface; it is retained in the API Evangelist network only as an identified Lightspeed portfolio company, not as an API provider.

providers.name: Core-Mark Holding
providers.description: Core-Mark Holding Company, a subsidiary of Performance Food Group, is one of the largest broad-line, full-service marketers and distributors of packaged consumer products to the convenience retail industry in North America. The company serves more than 41,000 retail locations across the United States and Canada, supplying tobacco, candy, snacks, beverages, foodservice, and other fast-moving consumer goods. Core-Mark provides retailer technology platforms including Core-Source Portal, Retailer Analytics, Core-Mark Ordering, and Core-Mark Intellisite.

providers.name: Diapers.com
providers.description: Diapers.com is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ecommerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Ecobites Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: Ecobites Pte. Ltd. operates Rec Rec, a Vietnamese consumer packaged-goods brand producing cricket-based snack foods marketed as high-protein, nutrient-dense alternatives to conventional snacks. Its product line spans cricket noodles (Mi Dam De), cricket puffs (Banh Phong De) in flavors such as Gochujang and Mala, and seasoned dried crickets (De Say). Products emphasize complete protein with a full amino-acid profile plus iron, zinc, magnesium, and potassium while keeping sodium low. Rec Rec is distributed through 7-Eleven, Farmers Market, Galaxy Cinema, BHD Cineplex, Naman Market, LS Place, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. It publishes a consumer e-commerce website but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Ecolab
providers.description: Ecolab is a Fortune 500 global leader in water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions and services. The company helps customers in food, healthcare, hospitality, industrial, and energy markets keep their environments clean, safe, and healthy while protecting people and vital resources.

providers.name: Effa
providers.description: Effa is a sustainable consumer goods company that makes the world's first 100% recyclable paper toothbrush, a disposable, plastic-free alternative to conventional plastic toothbrushes aimed at hotels, airlines, and retail consumers. Founded in Ukraine by Dasha and Ilya Kichuk and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company supplies eco-friendly personal care and amenity products to hospitality and travel clients, with reported customers including Netflix and Radisson. Effa is backed by 500 Global and Startup Wise Guys. Effa does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Folia Water
providers.description: Folia Water, Inc. is a clean-water social enterprise founded in 2016 by Jonathan Levine, Theresa Dankovich, and Cantwell Carson with the goal of bringing safe drinking water to 100 million people for pennies a day. The company manufactures Folia Filters, an affordable antimicrobial filter paper embedded with silver nanoparticles that kills 99.9999% of bacteria and 99.7% of viruses while removing protozoa and iron. Folia Water sells through distribution partners in emerging markets such as Bangladesh and is backed by 500 Global. It is a physical consumer-products manufacturer with no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Givemetap
providers.description: GiveMeTap is a UK-based social-enterprise consumer brand that designs and sells reusable, BPA-free stainless-steel and insulated water bottles (500ml and 700ml, plus custom co-branded bottles for businesses). For every bottle sold, GiveMeTap funds five years of clean drinking water for a person in Ghana, giving 20% of its revenue to water projects in Africa; the company reports 116,391 people reached with clean water for life. It operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront on the Shopify platform. GiveMeTap is a physical-products company with no first-party developer API, developer portal, or public API documentation; it was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub.

providers.name: Goyaz Silver Jewellery
providers.description: Goyaz Silver Jewellery is a Hyderabad-based Indian jewellery retail brand founded in January 2023 by Priyanka Vemuluri, specializing in 92.5 premium and gold-plated silver jewellery that blends traditional Indian craftsmanship with contemporary, occasion-led design. Operating a chain of 18 retail stores across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka (including Kukatpally, Punjagutta, Suchitra Circle, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam), Goyaz positions gold-plated silver as an accessible luxury alternative to gold. In October 2025 the company raised a Rs 130 crore (~$14.6M) Series A round led by Norwest Venture Partners, its first institutional funding, to expand its retail footprint, strengthen design and manufacturing, and enhance its omnichannel experience. The company operates an online storefront and social commerce presence but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: Hain Celestial Group
providers.description: The Hain Celestial Group is a leading organic and natural products company providing consumers with A Healthier Way of Life through a portfolio of natural, organic, and better-for-you brands. No public APIs or developer programs have been identified for Hain Celestial Group at this time.

providers.name: Hatcheri
providers.description: Hatcheri (Hatcheri Foods) is a food-focused incubator-accelerator based in San Leandro, California that partners with emerging food and beverage brands to build and scale them. Founded in 2013, it operates through three arms: Hatcheri Brands (leading day-to-day operations alongside founders), Hatcheri Advisory Services (hands-on strategic support across supply chain, marketing, sales, financial management, food safety, and product innovation), and Hatcheri Capital (investment and funding partnerships). Portfolio and partner brands include Sonoma Gourmet, Snapdragon, Fra' Mani, Sukhi's, and Sonoma Specialty Foods. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Hatcheri publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation; this profile is a company/provider identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: International Flavors & Fragrances
providers.description: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) is a global creator of flavors, fragrances, and ingredients for consumer products including perfumes, cosmetics, food, beverages, and household goods. IFF is a Fortune 500 company with no documented public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: J.M. Smucker
providers.description: The J.M. Smucker Company is a leading marketer and manufacturer of consumer food and beverage products and pet food and pet snacks in North America, with brands including Smucker's, Folgers, Jif, Milk-Bone, and Meow Mix.

providers.name: Keurig Green Mountain
providers.description: Keurig Green Mountain was a leader in specialty coffee and coffee makers, producing the Keurig single-serve brewing system and partnering with leading coffee brands. In 2018 Keurig Green Mountain merged with Dr Pepper Snapple Group to form Keurig Dr Pepper, a Fortune 500 beverage company. This repository preserves the historical API and developer footprint of Keurig Green Mountain prior to that merger.

providers.name: Kishlay Foods
providers.description: Kishlay Foods is a snack-food manufacturing company based in Guwahati, Assam, India, operating since 2003. The company produces premium potato chips, namkeens, and traditional Indian savory snacks, with regional varieties such as Aloo Bhujia, Bengali Mix, Chakna Mix, Cocktail Peanut, and Chana Jor Garam. Kishlay Foods runs a consumer/distributor marketing website and recruits distributor partners across the region; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, webhook, or developer-portal surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Land O'Lakes
providers.description: Land O'Lakes is a member-owned agricultural cooperative providing food, agriculture, and animal nutrition products to farmers, retailers, and consumers, with brands including Land O'Lakes butter and Purina Animal Nutrition.

providers.name: Levi Strauss
providers.description: Levi Strauss & Co. is one of the world's largest brand-name apparel companies and a global leader in jeanswear, designing and marketing jeans, casual wear, and related accessories under the Levi's, Dockers, Signature, and Denizen brands. The company does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Lorillard
providers.description: Lorillard Tobacco Company was the third-largest cigarette manufacturer in the United States, marketing cigarettes under brand names including Newport, Kent, True, and Old Gold. In 2015, Lorillard was acquired by Reynolds American Inc. (RAI), and its operations and brands have since been integrated into the Reynolds American family of companies. Lorillard does not operate a public developer program or API platform.

providers.name: Lyracollective
providers.description: Lyra Collective is a consumer-products holding company that owns and operates a portfolio of everyday care brands across skincare, feminine care, and family and pet products, including LOLA, EVER, QRX Labs, TriLASTIN, Nuvadermis, Natemia, Leash Boss, and Lusso Gear. It positions itself around "Exceptional Care, For Everyday Moments," emphasizing clean, quality essentials sold direct-to-consumer and through retail. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer-brands operator it publishes no public developer portal, API, or API documentation; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Madison-reed
providers.description: Madison Reed is a female-founded and female-led direct-to-consumer hair color company offering 8-Free permanent, demi-permanent, and root touch-up hair color crafted in Italy, sold as at-home kits and delivered as professional services at 95+ Hair Color Bar locations across the United States. The company blends e-commerce retail, subscription replenishment, and in-person salon booking. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and True Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: MBX
providers.description: MBX (formerly Memebox) is a global, multi-brand beauty and personal care company founded in 2012 and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2014 batch. Headquartered in San Francisco with operations in Seoul, Shanghai, and Taipei, MBX uses data-driven consumer insights and Korean beauty innovation to build and scale a portfolio of cosmetics brands — including Kaja, I Dew Care, Pony Effect, I'm Meme, and Nooni — sold through retail partners such as Sephora and Ulta. The company has raised over $190M from investors including Cowboy Ventures, Y Combinator, Formation 8, Goodwater Capital, Johnson & Johnson, and Pear VC. MBX operates as a direct-to-consumer and wholesale CPG business; it does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: McCormick
providers.description: McCormick spices and products have been kitchen must-haves since 1889. Learn about seasoning and cuisine while discovering tons of delicious recipes today. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: MeUndies
providers.description: MeUndies is a direct-to-consumer apparel brand based in Los Angeles, selling underwear, loungewear, socks, and basics online through a subscription membership and one-time purchase model. It operates as an e-commerce retailer at meundies.com rather than a developer platform: an enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 probed the domain and found no public API surface (api.meundies.com and developer.meundies.com both return 404, and no /.well-known/, /llms.txt, or OpenAPI documents were discoverable). This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and carries the domain-security probe result; it will gain API artifacts only if MeUndies publishes a developer program.

providers.name: Miracle Miles
providers.description: Miracle Miles (Miracle Miles Group) is a consumer footwear e-commerce company backed by Hongshan (Sequoia China). It designs, manufactures, and sells affordable fashion footwear and accessories direct-to-consumer through a family of online brands, including DREAM PAIRS (launched 2009), Bruno Marc (men's footwear), Nortiv 8 (outdoor), and Dream Pairs Kids, selling primarily via its own storefronts and large online marketplaces. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained as a company/lead record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Nobell Foods
providers.description: Nobell Foods is a molecular-farming food-technology company founded by Magi Richani that produces animal-free cheese from plant-grown casein. The company engineered soybean plants to grow the same dairy caseins found in animal milk, working with independent Midwest farmers to raise the crop from seed to flower, then converting the plant-derived proteins into cheese that melts, stretches, and tastes like conventional dairy. Backed by DCVC, Y Combinator, Andreessen Horowitz, and investors including Bill Gates and Robert Downey Jr., Nobell raised a $75M Series B and has since rebranded to Alpine Bio, with Nobell Foods continuing as the animal-free cheese brand and product unit. It is a consumer-packaged-goods and biotech company with no public API or developer program; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with verified public identity only.

providers.name: Pop Mart
providers.description: Pop Mart International Group is a Chinese pop-culture and designer-toy company best known for its blind-box collectibles and character IP such as Labubu (The Monsters), Molly, Skullpanda and Dimoo. Headquartered in Beijing and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it operates retail stores, robot-shop vending machines, and a consumer e-commerce presence across China and international markets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan/Sequoia China). Consumer sector; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no developer portal, /.well-known documents, or llms.txt).

providers.name: PPG Industries
providers.description: PPG Industries is a Fortune 500 global supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials serving customers in construction, consumer products, industrial, transportation markets, and aftermarkets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with PPG Industries. As of the last review, no public APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Pure Watercraft
providers.description: Pure Watercraft was a Seattle, Washington electric marine propulsion company founded in 2011 by Andy Rebele. It built electric outboard motors marketed as drop-in replacements for 20 to 50 horsepower gas engines, along with lithium-ion battery packs, chargers and Wi-Fi throttle controls, plus a consumer companion mobile app that pulled trip history and telemetry off the outboard over Bluetooth and pushed firmware updates to it. General Motors took a reported 25 percent stake in 2021. The company wound down and sold its assets in 2024, with the outboard line acquired by Raider Outboards and other assets going to a Seattle electric boat club. purewatercraft.com and the former companion-app host app.purewatercraft.com both now 301 to www.pureoutboards.com, the Pure Electric Outboard storefront operated by the acquirer. Pure Watercraft never published a public developer program, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API contract; its telemetry cloud was private to its own mobile app.

providers.name: Quirky
providers.description: Quirky was a crowdsourced consumer-product invention platform (founded by Ben Kaufman) that let inventors submit ideas the community helped design, manufacture and sell; it was backed by a16z among others. The company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2015. As of this enrichment pass the quirky.com domain is a parked "domain name is for sale" page with no operating product, developer portal, or API surface. This profile is retained as a defunct a16z portfolio-company lead; no API artifacts exist to enrich.

providers.name: Rothys
providers.description: Rothy's is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer footwear and accessories brand founded in 2012, known for washable shoes and bags 3D-knitted from recycled materials such as post-consumer plastic water bottles and marine plastics. Its catalog spans flats, loafers, sneakers, Mary Janes, clogs, sandals, heels, and boots for women, men, and kids, alongside totes, crossbody bags, wallets, and backpacks. The company ships to 40+ countries and emphasizes sustainable, seamless-knit manufacturing that reduces waste. Rothy's was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and web presence for the catalog.

providers.name: Sampler
providers.description: Sampler (The Sampler App Inc., Toronto) was a digital product-sampling platform used by consumer packaged goods (CPG) and retail brands to run targeted sample-distribution campaigns, collect first-party consumer data and reviews, and measure the impact of sampling on purchase behavior. Founded in 2013, it acquired Abeo and AdMass in 2023 and served brands including Procter & Gamble, Unilever, L'Oreal, Nestle and PepsiCo. THE COMPANY IS DEFUNCT: it filed for bankruptcy on 2024-06-27 with CAD 12.9M in liabilities against roughly CAD 300K in assets, and ceased operations. As of 2026-08-12 the entire estate is decommissioned — sampler.io and www.sampler.io fail the TLS handshake outright, api.sampler.io retains stale DNS records whose hosts refuse all connections, and every documentation or developer subdomain is NXDOMAIN. Sampler never published a public developer API, developer portal, documentation host, OpenAPI, or machine discovery surface; the api.sampler.io/v1/ endpoints visible in archived crawls were the private backend of its consumer claim widget and admin console, not a documented developer product.

providers.name: Saturnbird Coffee
providers.description: Saturnbird Coffee (三顿半) is a Chinese specialty coffee company known for premium instant coffee made with its proprietary REPUS extraction technology (cold extraction plus intelligent drying) using 100% Arabica beans. Its numbered Number Series and Express Series products, a Red Dot Design Award winner and Specialty Coffee Association member, are sold direct-to-consumer online and through collaborations with roasters including April Coffee, Kurasu, Monogram Coffee, and Fritz Coffee Company. Backed by Hongshan (HSG), it was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce brand with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Studio Moderna
providers.description: Studio Moderna is one of the largest multichannel direct-to-consumer retailers across Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and beyond, founded in 1992 and headquartered in Emmen, Switzerland, with major operations based in Ljubljana, Slovenia. The company reaches consumers through TV direct-response (Top Shop), e-commerce, print catalogs, call centers, and physical retail stores in roughly twenty countries. Its portfolio of house brands spans sleep and home (Dormeo), kitchenware (Delimano), footwear and wellness (Walkmaxx), and health and lifestyle products (Kosmodisk, Rovus, WellNeo). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company exposes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: SuperValu
providers.description: SuperValu was one of the largest grocery retail and wholesale distribution companies in the United States before being acquired by United Natural Foods (UNFI) in 2018 for $2.9 billion. SuperValu operated retail grocery stores under multiple banners and provided wholesale distribution services. The supervalu.com domain now redirects to UNFI's wholesale food distribution platform. Suppliers interact with UNFI/SuperValu distribution through EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and the myUNFI supplier portal.

providers.name: Tastykake
providers.description: Tastykake is a Philadelphia-area baked snacks brand founded in 1914, known for Kandy Kakes, Krimpets, Juniors, and snack pies. It has been owned by Flowers Foods (NYSE: FLO) since 2011 and operates as a consumer packaged goods brand within the Flowers Foods portfolio alongside Nature's Own, Wonder, and Dave's Killer Bread. No public, developer-facing APIs have been identified for the Tastykake brand; partner, retailer, and distribution integrations are handled through Flowers Foods' internal EDI and account-managed channels rather than a public developer portal.

providers.name: Three Squirrels
providers.description: Three Squirrels (三只松鼠) is a Chinese consumer snack company founded in 2012 by Zhang Liaoyuan and headquartered in Wuhu, Anhui Province. Positioned as one of China's first internet-native food brands, it sells nuts, seeds, dried fruits, baked goods, and other leisure snacks primarily through e-commerce channels (Tmall, JD.com, and its own storefronts) alongside a growing offline retail footprint. The company is publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange ChiNext board (stock code 300783). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; as a consumer packaged-goods retailer it does not publish a public developer API, open platform, or API documentation. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: Wonder Brands
providers.description: Wonder Brands is a Latin American digital-first e-commerce company that builds and operates a portfolio of 15+ consumer product brands (including AlebriPets, Tropical Heal, Somos Reyes, Kingsman, KingsHouse, and KingsPort) spanning mattresses and bedroom furniture, sports equipment, home appliances, travel gear, tools, home and garden furniture, pet and baby products, and personal care. Operating an online-first omnichannel model across Uruguay, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile, it fulfills over 2 million annual orders from 25,000+ square meters of warehouse space, backed by proprietary technology for product optimization, marketing, pricing, and demand forecasting. Backed by QED Investors. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Henkel
providers.description: A German multinational company operating in adhesives, beauty care, and laundry and home care markets. Produces well-known consumer brands alongside industrial adhesive technologies used worldwide. No public developer API or developer portal was located; Henkel operates a Safety Data Sheets product portal at mysds.henkel.com but does not publish open developer APIs.

providers.name: ADM Labs
providers.description: ADM Labs is a Denver, Colorado hemp processor founded in 2017 by Arman Motiwalla as a subsidiary of ADM Group, running an extraction facility on Tejon Street that manufactured and wholesaled hemp-derived extracts - biomass, premium smokable, crude, distillate, isolate and water-soluble CBD, plus newer exotic cannabinoids - with white-label formulation for retail brands. It is a physical-goods manufacturer, not a software business, and never ran a developer program: its 2018-2021 site was a WordPress marketing site whose only transactional surface was a hosted Zoho Commerce storefront at store.adm-labs.com, with no API, SDK, webhook or developer link in its navigation. The company has since rebranded as Hemp Corp, which its original LinkedIn page still carries, and both adm-labs.com and the successor hempcorpusa.com now serve parking pages.

providers.name: Brandless
providers.description: Brandless is an American direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer of own-label food, beauty, personal care and household goods, founded in 2016 by Tina Sharkey and Ido Leffler and launched in July 2017. SoftBank-backed, it ceased operations on 10 February 2020; its assets were bought in June 2020 by Clarke Capital Partners and Ikonifi and the brand relaunched that summer under Utah-based ownership, later led by Cydni Tetro and then Tiffany Vail. The storefront ran on Shopify and sold physical consumer packaged goods only — Brandless never operated a developer program, public API, SDK or webhook surface of its own. As of this profile the brandless.com domain no longer resolves and the site is parked, so there is no live company surface to profile.

providers.name: Keurig Dr Pepper (formerly Dr Pepper Snapple Group)
providers.description: Dr Pepper Snapple Group was an integrated brand owner, manufacturer, and distributor of nonalcoholic beverages in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. In 2018 the company merged with Keurig Green Mountain to form Keurig Dr Pepper, a leading beverage company in North America with a portfolio of more than 150 brands including Dr Pepper, 7UP, Snapple, Canada Dry, Keurig, and Peet's Coffee.

providers.name: New Age Eats
providers.description: New Age Eats (founded 2018 in Berkeley, California as New Age Meats, rebranded to New Age Eats in 2022) was a cultivated-meat startup building cell-cultured pork sausage, combining plant protein with its own cultivated pork and a "sensomics" flavor program. It raised roughly $32 million, including a $25 million Series A in 2021 led by Hanwha Solutions, and was completing a pilot manufacturing plant in Alameda, California. Founder and CEO Brian Spears announced the company was winding down in March 2023, citing an inability to raise further capital in a turbulent market before it had any product to sell. It was a food-science company, never a software or API company: it published no developer portal, no documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Its remaining domain, newageeats.com, now serves a static archived copy of the former direct-to-consumer marketing site; the pre-rebrand domain newagemeats.com redirects to a host that no longer resolves.

providers.name: Perfumeo
providers.description: Perfumeo (Perfumeo(R)) is a consumer-hardware startup that built an AI-driven smart-home fragrance diffuser — a connected device holding scent capsules that its companion mobile app uses to adapt diffusion to the user's mood. The company describes itself as combining AI, data science, "green mechatronics" and green chemistry, and states it was founded in Paris in July 2021 and relocated to Cupertino, California in April 2023. It is an end-user product company: no public API, SDK, developer portal, webhook surface or machine-readable contract has ever been published, and none was found in this pass. As of 2026-08-26 the domain the company itself lists as its website, www.perfumeo-ai.com, no longer belongs to it — WHOIS shows the domain was created 2026-06-12 under a Dynadot privacy proxy on domain-parking nameservers, and it now serves a bot-challenge interstitial followed by a "Coming Soon" holding page. The company's LinkedIn page remains up and lists a headcount of one.

providers.name: Post Holdings
providers.description: Post Holdings is a consumer packaged goods holding company with businesses in center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice, food ingredient, and convenient nutrition product categories, with a brand portfolio that includes Post Consumer Brands, Bob Evans, Weetabix, and Michael Foods.

providers.name: Remilk
providers.description: Remilk is a food-technology company, founded in 2019 by Aviv Wolff and Ori Cohavi and headquartered in Rehovot, Israel, that produces animal-free dairy proteins by precision fermentation. The company inserts the gene that codes for a cow milk protein into a yeast strain from the same family used in brewing and baking, ferments it at scale, and harvests a milk protein it describes as identical to the bovine original but free of lactose, cholesterol, hormones and antibiotics; the protein is then formulated with non-animal fat and sugar, vitamins and minerals into finished dairy products. Remilk has raised more than $150M, and was the first company to win regulatory clearance for a precision-fermented dairy protein in Israel, with subsequent clearances in Singapore, the United States (GRAS) and Canada. In November 2025 it commercialised the ingredient with Gad Dairies, Israel's fourth-largest dairy company, launching "The New Milk" barista and retail line, and it has publicly paused its plan to build what would have been the world's largest precision fermentation facility in Denmark. Remilk sells a food ingredient and consumer dairy products, not software: it operates no developer program, publishes no API, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and maintains no public source-code organization.

providers.name: Cal-Maine Foods
providers.description: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. is the largest producer and distributor of fresh shell eggs in the United States. The company sells most of its shell eggs to grocery store chains, club stores, foodservice distributors, and egg product consumers across the country and produces specialty eggs including organic, cage-free, free-range, and nutritionally enhanced varieties. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Hanesbrands
providers.description: Hanesbrands is a global consumer apparel company designing, manufacturing, and selling everyday basic apparel under brands including Hanes, Champion, Bali, Maidenform, and Bonds. In 2025 Hanesbrands was acquired by Gildan, with both companies continuing to operate as a combined apparel leader.

providers.name: Kencko Foods
providers.description: Kencko is a direct-to-consumer functional-food company that makes no-fuss instant smoothies and other whole-food products from 100% organic, vegan, freeze-dried fruits and vegetables with no added sugars. Customers subscribe and shop through a Shopify-hosted online store at kencko.com. Kencko is a Techstars-backed portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub lead for the enrichment pipeline. It publishes no first-party developer API; the only machine-readable discovery surface on its domain is the Shopify Customer Account API OIDC/OAuth well-known configuration that backs storefront customer login.

providers.name: Newell Brands
providers.description: Newell Brands is a Fortune 500 global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, Parker, Elmer's, Oster, NUK, and Mr. Coffee.

providers.name: Newell Rubbermaid
providers.description: Newell Rubbermaid was a global marketer of consumer and commercial products with brands including Sharpie, Paper Mate, Rubbermaid, and Calphalon before merging with Jarden in 2016 to form Newell Brands.

providers.name: Reckitt Benckiser
providers.description: Reckitt Benckiser is a British multinational consumer-goods company focused on health, hygiene, and nutrition. Its portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Lysol, Dettol, Mucinex, Strepsils, Nurofen, Veet, Finish, Vanish, Air Wick, Calgon, Durex, and Enfamil/Mead Johnson infant nutrition, sold in nearly 200 markets. Reckitt operates as a pure consumer packaged-goods company with retail and e-commerce distribution; it does not publish a public developer API or open partner integration portal at the corporate level. B2B trading-partner connectivity with retailers and distributors is handled via standard EDI / GDSN flows rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: Tilray Brands
providers.description: A global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company operating across cannabis, beverage alcohol, and wellness segments. One of the largest cannabis companies worldwide with cultivation, processing, and distribution operations spanning North America, Europe, and beyond.

providers.name: Crocs
providers.description: Crocs, Inc. is a global designer, manufacturer, and retailer of casual footwear known for its iconic molded clog. The company sells through e-commerce, owned retail, and wholesale channels worldwide and also owns the HEYDUDE casual footwear brand. Crocs does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Flowers Foods
providers.description: Flowers Foods is one of the largest producers and marketers of packaged bakery foods in the United States, with brands including Nature's Own, Wonder, Dave's Killer Bread, Tastykake, and Mrs. Freshley's. No public, developer-facing APIs have been identified for this company; partner and retailer integrations appear to be handled through internal EDI and account-managed channels.

providers.name: Hillshire Brands
providers.description: Hillshire Brands was a U.S.-based food company that produced and sold meat-centric food solutions including Jimmy Dean, Ball Park, Hillshire Farm, State Fair, and Sara Lee branded products. The company was acquired by Tyson Foods in 2014 and its operations have been integrated into the Tyson Foods organization. Hillshire Brands does not currently publish a public developer API or API documentation.

providers.name: Kellanov
providers.description: Kellanov is a tracking alias profile for Kellanova, the global snacks-led consumer packaged foods company formed in 2023 from the spin-off of the Kellogg Company's snacks, international cereal and noodles, and North American frozen breakfast businesses. Brands include Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, Eggo, RXBAR, MorningStar Farms, and Special K outside North America. The canonical profile is maintained at api-evangelist/kellanova.

providers.name: Kellanova
providers.description: Kellanova is a global snacks-led consumer packaged foods company, formed in 2023 from the spin-off of the Kellogg Company's snacks, international cereal and noodles, and North American frozen breakfast businesses. Kellanova owns and markets brands including Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, Eggo, RXBAR, MorningStar Farms, and Special K outside North America.

providers.name: Kellogg
providers.description: The Kellogg Company is a historic American multinational food manufacturer founded in 1906 by W.K. Kellogg in Battle Creek, Michigan. In 2023 the company split into two independent public companies: WK Kellogg Co, which retained the North American cereal business (Frosted Flakes, Rice Krispies, Special K, Corn Flakes, Raisin Bran), and Kellanova, which took the global snacks business and international cereal portfolio (Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, Eggo, RXBAR). This profile tracks the legacy Kellogg corporate identity and links forward to the two successor entities.

providers.name: Kraft Foods Group
providers.description: Kraft Foods Group was a North American grocery business that produced packaged food and beverages including cheese, refrigerated meals, refreshment beverages, coffee, and convenient meals before merging with H.J. Heinz to form The Kraft Heinz Company in 2015.

providers.name: Kraft Heinz
providers.description: The Kraft Heinz Company is one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, producing iconic brands including Kraft, Heinz, Oscar Mayer, Philadelphia, Velveeta, Lunchables, Planters, and Maxwell House. Kraft Heinz does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mead Johnson Nutrition
providers.description: Mead Johnson Nutrition was a manufacturer of infant formula and other pediatric nutrition products before being acquired by Reckitt Benckiser in 2017. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: MeadWestvaco
providers.description: MeadWestvaco was a global packaging company providing packaging solutions to many of the world's most-admired brands in the personal and beauty care, food, beverage, home and garden, and other industries. In 2015 MeadWestvaco merged with Rock-Tenn to form WestRock, and the MeadWestvaco brand has since been retired. No public APIs or developer resources are documented for the legacy MeadWestvaco entity or for its WestRock successor.

providers.name: Performance Food Group
providers.description: Performance Food Group is one of the largest foodservice distributors in North America, marketing and distributing food and food-related products to independent and chain restaurants and other institutional customers.

providers.name: Vida
providers.description: Vida is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global, gv, slow-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Ample
providers.description: Ample Foods is a nutrition company that makes single-serving meal-replacement shakes sold direct-to-consumer at amplemeal.com. Its lineup includes Ample Original, a low-carb meal shake with roughly 25g protein and 4g net carbs per 400-calorie serving, and Ample Recover, a higher-carb performance shake with about 31g protein and 33g carbs per 400-calorie serving, sold in ready-to-drink bottles and bulk canisters. Ample is a consumer packaged-goods brand running on a Shopify storefront; enrichment probing found no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or API reference. This profile is a portfolio lead backed by 500 Global and is retained as a company record with no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Winnebago Industries
providers.description: Winnebago Industries is a leading North American manufacturer of outdoor lifestyle products under the Winnebago, Grand Design, Newmar, Chris-Craft, Barletta, and Lithionics Battery brands. The company designs, manufactures, and markets recreational vehicles, marine products, and supporting components. Winnebago Industries does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Unilever
providers.description: A British-Dutch multinational consumer goods company with a portfolio spanning food, personal care, and household brands. Owns over 400 brands including Dove, Ben & Jerry's, Hellmann's, and Vaseline sold in 190 countries.

providers.name: Darling Ingredients
providers.description: Darling Ingredients is a global developer and producer of sustainable natural ingredients from edible and inedible bio-nutrients, creating products for the food, pet food, feed, fuel, bioenergy, and fertilizer industries. Darling operates Diamond Green Diesel as a renewable diesel joint venture with Valero, and brands such as Rousselot (gelatin and collagen), Sonac, CTH, and EnviroFlight. Darling does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Essity
providers.description: Essity is a Swedish-headquartered global hygiene and health company operating across four business areas: Health & Medical, Personal Care, Consumer Tissue, and Professional Hygiene. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ESSITY) and owns roughly 40 brands including TENA (incontinence care), Tork (professional hygiene), Libero (baby diapers), Libresse / Bodyform / Nana / Saba / Nuvenia / Libra (feminine care), Modibodi and Knix (period underwear), JOBST (compression hosiery), Leukoplast (adhesive bandages), Cutimed, Sorbact, Hydrofera and Actimove (wound care, sports medicine, orthopedic supports), Delta-Cast (casting), and consumer tissue brands Lotus, Zewa, Tempo, Cushelle, Plenty, Velvet, Regio, Sorbent and Purex. No public developer-facing APIs or developer portal have been identified for Essity; this repository tracks corporate, brand, sustainability, investor, and integration surfaces for ongoing API discovery. The company's Tork brand ships a connected washroom data platform — Tork Vision Cleaning — which is the closest thing to a public data surface in the portfolio.

providers.name: SOURCE Global
providers.description: SOURCE Global, PBC (founded as Zero Mass Water) is a Scottsdale, Arizona public benefit corporation started in 2014 by Arizona State University materials scientist Cody Friesen to make drinking water out of sunlight and air. Its SOURCE Hydropanel is an off-grid solar-thermal device that pulls water vapor from the atmosphere, condenses and mineralizes it, and delivers roughly five liters of drinking water a day; the panels were deployed in residential, commercial, community and humanitarian projects across more than 50 countries, and the company later moved into bottled water, acquiring Proud Source Water in 2023. It raised approximately USD 270 million in total, including a USD 50 million Series C led by BlackRock in 2020 and a USD 130 million Series D in 2022 co-led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures and the Drawdown Fund with Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund and Fifth Wall participating. SOURCE was a hardware and consumer-products business rather than a software vendor: it never published a developer portal, API reference, SDK or any machine-readable API contract, and the only machine-readable surface its site ever exposed was the Shopify platform behind its direct-to-consumer storefront. The company went quiet during 2025 — an April 2025 SEC filing showed a USD 75 million raise that closed at USD 19.3 million, and founder Cody Friesen announced his departure in June 2025 — and as of August 2026 source.co answers HTTP 402 "Store unavailable" on every path while the legacy zeromasswater.com domain resolves to a parked GoDaddy builder page.

providers.name: Molson Coors Beverage
providers.description: Molson Coors Beverage Company is one of the world's largest brewers, with a portfolio of beers and beverages including Coors Light, Miller Lite, Coors Banquet, Blue Moon, Carling, and many others.

providers.name: Mondelez
providers.description: Mondelez International is a Fortune 500 multinational confectionery, food, and beverage company that owns iconic snack brands including Oreo, Cadbury, Milka, Toblerone, Trident, Ritz, and Triscuit.

providers.name: besunyen
providers.description: Besunyen is a Chinese consumer-health company known for herbal weight-management, functional and detox teas plus related wellness and nutrition products, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment on 2026-07-18 found no public developer, API, or documentation surface — besunyen.com serves only an nginx 404 and its TLS certificate is issued for besunyen.co (hostname mismatch); the only real artifact captured is a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Cabinet Health
providers.description: Cabinet Health is an end-to-end supply chain platform for private-label over-the-counter (OTC) medicines. The company develops, sources, manufactures, and delivers OTC products across 70+ active ingredients in tablet, softgel, capsule, liquid, powder, gummy, and chewable formats to retailers, wholesalers, and online marketplaces, emphasizing sustainable, refillable packaging and quality assurance at scale. Cabinet also produces its own certified B Corp consumer brand sold on Amazon and Target. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer or API surface has been found for this provider.

providers.name: Church and Dwight
providers.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is a Fortune 500 American consumer packaged goods (CPG) company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, that manufactures and markets a portfolio of household, personal care, health and wellness, beauty, and specialty products. Best known as the parent company of the Arm & Hammer baking soda brand (the company's flagship since 1846), Church & Dwight operates through three reporting segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division. The company's brand portfolio includes Arm & Hammer, Trojan, OxiClean, Vitafusion, L'il Critters, Therabreath, Hero (Mighty Patch), Batiste, Waterpik, OraJel, Nair, Spinbrush, First Response, RepHresh, Zicam, Flawless, Toppik, Viviscal, Kaboom, Orange Glo, XTRA laundry detergent, and Arrid antiperspirant. Church & Dwight does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are managed through internal portals, and consumer experiences focus on brand websites, e-commerce direct-to-consumer storefronts, and the Innovation Portal for external R&D partnerships.

providers.name: IncreBio
providers.description: IncreBio (formerly JuiceInnov8) is a Thai food-biotech company founded in 2017 that uses biology to create the next generation of healthier food and drinks. Its flagship product, INCREDIBLE Juice, is a 100% juice with roughly 70% less sugar than standard juice, about 30 calories and 5g of fiber per serving, under the tagline "Make Juice and War on Sugar." IncreBio is backed by 500 Global. It is a consumer food-and-beverage brand with no public API, developer platform, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Rawsome Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: Rawsome Pte. Ltd. (trading as Rawsome Asia Beverages) is a Singapore-based producer and distributor of small-batch, handcrafted raw kombucha sold under the Wild Boocha brand. The company brews fermented tea beverages -- including Citrus Green, Strawberry Mint, and Harmony Adaptogenic flavors -- available in one-liter bottles and refillable mini kegs, and markets them as a functional wellness drink rich in probiotics, polyphenols, B vitamins, vitamin C, organic enzymes, and amino acids. Rawsome operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront (built on Odoo) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. This profile currently has no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; it is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Enya
providers.description: Enya is a Singapore-based sustainable period-care consumer brand backed by 500 Global (500 Southeast Asia) and Crusade Partners. Founded by Christian Teo, Enya sells certified organic cotton sanitary pads, liners, tampons, menstrual cups, period underwear and heating patches direct-to-consumer and via subscription (15/30/45/90-day cadence) across Singapore, Asia and the Middle East, through its enya.sg storefront, Shopee and retail partners such as DKSH. It is a consumer packaged-goods / e-commerce business with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Your Super
providers.description: Your Super (Your Superfoods, Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer plant-based superfoods brand founded in 2015 in Venice, California by Michael Kuech and Kristel de Groot. It sells functional superfood and protein mixes and bars made from five to six nutrient-dense whole-food ingredients that are certified organic, Non-GMO, glyphosate-free, and gluten-free, sold through Shopify storefronts in the US and Europe and via Amazon. The company raised roughly $22.5M across five rounds from investors including 500 Global and PowerPlant Ventures, and was acquired by The Healing Company in October 2022. It is a consumer e-commerce brand and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Before Brands
providers.description: Before Brands, Inc. was a Menlo Park, California science-based food and nutrition company founded on Stanford allergy research by Dr. Kari Nadeau, best known for SpoonfulOne — a consumer early-allergen-introduction product line that blended sixteen commonly allergenic proteins into daily servings for infants and toddlers. Nestle Health Science took a minority stake plus ex-US licensing rights in 2019 and later absorbed the business outright. It was a consumer packaged goods company, not a software company: it never operated a developer program, published no API, SDK or webhook surface, and its own domain is now controlled by Nestle and no longer serves a site.

providers.name: Advanced Bio Development
providers.description: Advanced Bio Development, Inc. (ABD) was a New Jersey beverage and dietary-supplement company headquartered in Englewood Cliffs, NJ. It developed, produced and marketed X2PERFORMANCE, a patented all-natural liquid sports-energy supplement built around ATP, created by founder Dr. Ralph Ferrante as an alternative to conventional performance stimulants, and distributed in part through Anheuser-Busch InBev's AB ONE network. The company sold consumer packaged goods through retail and e-commerce; software was never its product and it never operated a developer program, public API, SDK or developer portal. In March 2023 X2 Performance merged into the Don't Quit! beverage platform — ABD and existing X2 investors became shareholders in Don't Quit!, X2 CEO Mark French took the same role at the combined company, and Keurig Dr Pepper remained majority owner — after which the X2 brand was wound down. The brand domain x2performance.com is no longer controlled by the company: WHOIS lists the registrant organization as HugeDomains.com and the site 302s to a domain-resale listing, while advancedbiodevelopment.com does not resolve. This record is retained as an honest zero — a consumer-packaged-goods company with no API surface, whose only remaining public presence is third-party listings.
